text:
Quaint repurposed venue, exquisite locally-sourced food, and reservations are strongly recommended.
This venue has a revolving menu that uses locally-sourced products to create unique and pricey entrees not found within many many miles away. The food was memorable, but the service slow primarily due to a large party of 20 people in an establishment of about 40+ seats.
Immediately prior to our arrival at 5:15 pm, a party of six people eithout reservations were refused seats even though seating was available for the next 75 minutes, most likely due to the presence of the large party of 20 people.
I noted no up-selling and all prices were clearly published.

text:
EAT is a delicious farm to table restaurant with chef inspired meals cooked to perfection. They deliver all the flavors of the city, with the comfort of the country. The chef often will stop by each table to introduce himself after the food comes put and the rich history of multiple generations on the restaurant industry gives EAT an extra since of nostalgia. We ordered the beef tips and noodles and have never experienced a dish so delicious. We have also been for the brunch several times and have thoroughly enjoyed our selections.
It's probably a good idea to make reservations in advance for weekends, but it's always worth the detour to Dodge Nebraska for the experience of dining at EAT.

name: Patricia Valentine
text:
***EDITED***READ MORE BELOW***
Oh my glob, this is just the most perfect little dining spot I've been yet, and I only know about it because my Grandparents are locals. So apparently the chef was a head honcho in some big city and he gave it up to live the simple life. (Not sure if its true) regardless, the food is amazing. The portion sizes are MORE than generous and the price is to scale.

My favorite part is the location! Its sitting in an old bank, the vault is still there, original ceiling. Just a super neat place. Would recommend to everyone to try once.

EDIT!!! So my grandfather is in a wheel chair so sometimes going out to eat can be difficult. I decided instead of loading him into the van for a 3 minute drive we could just order something to go. The menu changes daily so there is no way to look up what is being served online. I decided to call and ask what menu specials of the night were. When I called the person on the phone (assuming the owner) was rude and told me he wasn't going to read me everything off the menu, understandable enough. No one wants to waste time during rush hour. So I decided that myself would drive there, look through the menu, find something for me and grandparents to eat, and then order it to go.

I walked into EAT and the young woman working the counter told me that she would need to talk to her boss. That they don't allow all menu items to be carried out... ohkay? Then when she returned to me she again told me that her boss prefers it if people come in to eat instead of carry out. I explained to her that with my current position, coming in and eating wasn't really a good option. Instead of the woman sympathizing, she just walked away from me. The owner of the restaurant hid behind in his kitchen and just stared me down with death glares. I soon realized they weren't going to take my order and allow me to carry out.

I will never understand how a business will turn someone away like that and be so rude to customers. Because of this I am changing my review. The food may be good (not that I was able to eat there a second time) but customer service is what makes a successful business.

name: Tony Hill
text:
We had to wait to be seated, as the greeter was MIA, and when she came, she seemed a little lost as to what whe needed to do with us. After we were seated, we then had to wait an almost unreasonable amount of time before a server came with menus.
However, when our food came out, it was timely and hot and tasted spot on and the rest of the visit went without a hitch.
The country store section is always a plus, as it always takes me back to some of the days of my childhood.
The bathrooms, storefront and dining area were all very clean and our visit overall was pleasant, though the overall atmosphere was a little stale.
The dining room staff could be a little friendlier and though masks hide smiles, they don't disguise overall attitude.
I will go back to this one, however, just for the food experience.

The prices were very reasonable. I rate this store as high value for great service, great location, reasonable prices, plenty choices, and quality/quantity of the food. Recommended.

name: David Huntington
text:
We have eaten at the cracker barrel many times. This time I had a French dip sandwich. Big mistake, the first bite was nothing but onion. I found some meat in the second bite and finished the first half of the sandwich. I then opened the second half and saw a cursory lump meat and cheese melted together, and an equal amount of fried onion.
I complained to the manager about the portion size telling him that I saw more meat in a McDonald's hamburger. He replied that was his portion size but that he would make me another one if I wanted. He returned five minutes later to inform me that it would take a while. I told him to forget it.
To be fair he did not charge us for our meal, but it will be a very long time before I ever step into that establishment again.

name: Bess

I felt sorry for the couple she wasn't talking to, because the server was hanging on the woman's chair and they would of had to talk over her to have a conversation. Our server was just as bad at her job. We couldn't get her or anyone else to bring us cream for the coffee until it was cold, we couldn't get her back at our table until it was time to leave. She failed to tell us about up charges for sides... I took it out of the tip she wasn't getting. No service no tip.

name: David Forney
text: The Applebee's restaurant in Fremont Nebraska is one of my favorites of the Applebee's chain. The service is always fast and friendly, and the place is always busy. It isn't just that Fremont is lacking in good dining... Although they are... It's that the management at Applebee's does a good job of taking care of their customers. On this visit, we did have a small problem with the order. The manager stepped in to resolve it quickly. Things don't always go perfectly, but they react to it appropriately. The food quality is great, and that isn't true for every Applebee's location. Everything came out hot and delicious.

resp.text: David, thank you for stopping in, and thank you for sharing.   Have a great day.   Curtis Barnes, Area Director.

name: Michelle Peterson

name: karl graff
text: Our order, a hamburger without pickles, had 6 pickles on it. I had the quesadilla burger which looked nothing like the picture, and then  devolved into greasy pools on my plate. I didn't finish out of pity... My son, who has never met a burger he didn't love, left over half of his. I tasted the, actual burger and it was grainy and really salty. I don't know how you screw up a bacon cheeseburger. And it wasn't the bacon that made it salty, it was the burger. I feel bad for the servers because the kitchen probably costs them tips. Never again... I took my son to dinner as a reward. I felt so bad that I took him somewhere else for dessert. Let me be your cautionary tale...

name: Dakota Murphy
text: Always have great prices and sales, I love their fuelsavers! The employees are polite and professional.

name: DENISE SHANNON
text: Friendly place with great deals. Always save a lot of money on gas with my Fuel Saver Card with all the special deals that they have. You just have to watch their specials. I had enough points that I only had to pay the state fuel tax. 20 gallons cost me $0.18, now that's a deal!

name: Cody Xander
text: Didn't have a problem. Didn't have much of what I wanted but I still found something good enough on my way through.

name: Chris Nielsen
text: Fuel saver program is not worth the trouble, Have to buy special items to qualify.  Plus it limits you to 20 gallons of discounted fuel.  I have a 32 gallon tank.  Good selection and they have some good prices.

name: John Cooper
text: Great store and selection. Friendly and helpful staff. Great specials.

name: Troy Magnuson
text: I haven't been to this HyVee in quite a bit.   I was impressed with how well stocked it is.  I was also pleased with politeness of the staff.

name: Eatta Nachos
text: A typical hy vee. Tis decent.

name: Anna McKinney
text: Very nice store, seem to always be clean and stocked but I swear the aisles are set up in an intentionally confusing way. I love the hyvee made chips and sushi here.

name: Willdabeast 58
text: Love the wine and spirits, but didn't have Henny so that was lame. And has a decent selection of cigars

name: Eileen Tant
text: It's a busy store but good.  Produce is the freshes I know in town and they do have friendly workers and helpful when they aren't busy helping someone else.

name: Ryan Trost
text: Without the name on the front of the store, you would never think this was the same place as the ones in West O. Which is a shame. I’ve asked about lack of products (basic things like peppers, and potatoes) predictable produce, and was told “supply chain issues with COVID” yet the stpres in West O which I imagine get the same trucks, magically are never out of what I need.

name: Jess Redding
text: I was able to be checked out in a timely fashion by a person, not a free computer employee.

name: Luke Hay
text: This for the aisle online: not only did I have to sit there for 30 min after calling and texting. But my frozen food is now completely thawed. Definitely need to get thins figured out there. Will no longer be shopping at hy vee because of this

name: Seth Feala
text: I'm always a great place to get groceries

name: Rickys Schuetze
text: Good place to shop a lot of goog fresh meat selections

name: Kathy Raddatz
text:
There is always ready to help you find anything the store is always clean
It's a great place to buy groceries
.

name: Andrew Burbach
text: Kinda gross, the gentleman that help me today in the meat department wasn't wearing gloves touched my 2 peppers I bought as well as the 20 brouts I bought as well. Maybe you guys should work on wearing gloves back there. Will stick with going somewhere else for my meats now.

name: Marshall Burns
text: They had everything I needed at good prices from there ads.

name: PRM DSM
text: I get my pickup groceries here on a regular basis.

name: Kevin Keith
text: They have great chicken try a hot dinner potatoes good deli food 😋😋 take your family enjoy

name: Sheryl Spies
text: I think the place is great they clean their belts between each customer and I always find what I need.

name: Phantom Jewel Photography
text: Pharmacy girl was really rude and somehow my husbands address and information ended up on their servers when she was questioned about it she became rude and unprofessional !!!

name: Tammy E
text: Store is always clean, friendly and helpful staff, produce looks good, usually well stocked.

name: Pamela Coso
text: Shopping checking my list pulled mask down top nostrils (glasses fogging up) . This rainbow bright entitled 20 something starts telling me how wear my mask! There are people in store with no mask on and people of her own age in parking lot in group of ten not wearing mask.

text: First time I've been to the Fremont Hy Vee. It was very clean and well stocked.

name: Larry Morency
text: Great selection of alcohol on their spirits department

text: Clean facility appreciated. Wish they would stop moving shelve placement of goods.

text:
Shrimp.  I love their fresh Gulf Shrimp!

text: If you can eat it, they stock it. Their salad bar was expansive. Good selection of bagels and other baked goods. Well stocked deli. Their "sit down and spend awhile" Sunday breakfast has a super variety of comfort foods.

text: Alot of times has not enough grocery advertised, out of stock alot. Sometimes pricey

text: Best store

name: GXM
text: Good prepared food again 👍

name: Ashley McDonald
text: Found what I needed, but price was extremely high. And they never put my points for fuel saver on. text: Produce is always fresh and they have almost all of the hard-to-find ingredients you need for international cooking.

text: They have change of address forms! Which was awesome because the post office was closed.

name: Daleen Robeson
text: Good selection of items

text: Love this store!  Very clean  and always friendly service. Easy to find what you need and prices are reasonable.

name: Denise Boozer
text: Very good bargains. Staff very friendly and helpful.

name: David Deal
text: Great store

name: Glen barton
text: It was quick and easy

name: James Latshaw
text: My last two visits to this location where not good ones.  They have expired products in the health section.  Last time it was a coconut water and this time it was health bars.  After looking more these products expired 3 to 4 months ago.  I told them about it last time and just told them again. So please look at all the dates to make sure you don't get sick!!

name: Scott Johnson
text: Great customer service as always.  A special thanks to Chris for his assistance.

name: Robin Schneider
text: Very nice staff. Helpful.

name: Sharon Von seggern
text: Always great service. Never over one person in checkout line. I like that i can find what i am looking for as opposed to other stores in the area. You have to search for things.

name: Theresa Mckinley
text: We frequently shop here.  I like to support the local businesses.  Typically clean, produce is usually fresh and stocked or currently being restocked as I am there.  Staff is normally helpful at the deli and meat counters.  We like the Chinese food from the deli.  Flowers are normally longer lasting from here compared to some other places.

name: Veronica Marsh
text: Wonderful shopping expierance !   Today they were short on merchandise !

name: Miles Merritt
text: Great selection of local beer and jam and other random stuff, friendly staff

text: Both the checkout girl and the lady serving the chinese food were extremely friendly

name: Joel Anderson

I am a member of the saving catchers and have saved about 200 dollars over the 2 or so years it's been going on, I check our store ads from the small town stores close to us, and I have never had a problem with price matching, it's just common since, find the product price you want to match in the ad you have, find the same name same weight product you want to buy, take that item to the check out and there you have it your product at your price, I've had a checker want to see the ad but that's OK with me, I always bring my ads with me.

text:
Not initially impressed...but I called in tonight because my wife had gone in this morning and could not find a specific carseat. She was told to go to another area and they would help her. She was told it should be there but it isn't and they didn't know we're to find it. She left her number but was not told when she would receive a call. Or an even approximate time it might be there.
I was frustrated by this, so I called in with the upc and spoke with the assistant manager named Amanda. She took my name and number and said she would call me back and let me know if it was in store or when it might be arriving.
30 minutes later she called me back. She had found the car seat on the truck (a feet she didn't have to go through but did) she unloaded multiple pallets of freight in order to retrieve the item I needed. This is going above and beyond and I hope she is recognized for doing so much work for a single customer while she works for such a large company that can afford to lose a small sale of 65 dollars.
That is how to build a business...I will be back.
Thank you Amanda

text: The hotel is nice = the room was nice and clean, the air conditioner worked well, the bed and pillows were comfortable. We had a small balcony, which was nice. The staff were all nice and helpful. Of the five floors in the hotel, only one had a working ice machine. My biggest negative towards the room was the curtains were not very good. They let in the light at night and even worse in the morning. Even though we were right outside the elevators, it was still quiet in the room.

name: Chris Wright
text:
We brought our family of 6 here for a staycation.  The water park is phenomenal!  There is something for all ages, including a separate, gated zero-entry pool for littles with fountains and slides.  The lazy river isn't policed, so we were getting bowled over by kids and even adults who were pushing their way through.  There are slides for all ages...the big ones have a height restriction of 48 inches.  All in all, definitely worth the money.

You must bring your own towels or you'll have to rent some.  And you can't bring ANY outside food...forget bringing your dinner in!

IMPORTANT!! If you're planning on staying at the hotel, the water park is NOT INCLUDED with third party bookings or even a standard booking through the hotel! We found this out the hard way.  You have to book with a water park package, otherwise you still have to pay separately, and it is expensive on the weekends.  Like $20 per person ages 3 and up. Ages 2 and under are free.

All that to say this is a fantastic get away for your family...your kids will love it!

text: Went her for just the day we did not have a hotel room. First it was incredibly expensive to get into. Me and my husband paid 40 a person just to get in on a Saturday. The water park itself is really geared towards children and had only a couple of things for adults or older children. The water slides were a lot of fun as was the lazy river. Although the lazy river has some big chunks missing in the floor and my husband cut his toe pretty good. We were with my husband's family and they had small children there that did really enjoy themselves. The water its self was quite cold though and we had to take the kids out to warm up a couple of times. The food available was good and reasonably priced. They even had vegetarian options. I found the locker rooms a bit small for as many people as there were for a Saturday. Overall I thought this was extremely over priced for what it was. Definitely book a room or get discounted tickets otherwise it's not worth the money.

name: Jamms 4
text:
This place tells me two days before we arrive that they are closing the park for "maintenance". Huh?? The ENTIRE PARK?? Outrageous!! Now I have 4 kids and 2 of my friends kids crying because they can't go. Can't they do the maintenance during the 4-5 days they aren't even open?? Something is shifty.
Then when I call to cancel no one answers the phone. And then when they finally do answer, they are rude to me?? What?? How is it my fault your water park chooses the days they are open to do maintenance. Oh and since I canceled with in the two day mark they charged me $25. It is a scam. The only reason people stay there is for the water park and then two days before hand they say it's closed so then they just get $25 for absolutely nothing. Hmmmmm....
I have a gift card to the place and it looks like I'm not using. Not worth my kids heart break. I'll spend a little extra and go to Great Wolf Lodge instead. At least I know they aren't going to break my kids hearts.

name: Samanatha Jones
text: Such an awesome place to go for family swimming!! We spent 6 hours here! The staff is even amazing! My kids wear plugs for their ears and we lost one, they helped us look for them and we found them!! I'd defiantly go again!!

name: Martha J
text: Lots of fun for the whole family! Different water depths and pool sizes so everyone from big to small can enjoy!

name: Amy Bond
text: I am unsure where the leadership is for this facility  but the standards of cleanliness are very much lacking. There was poop smeared on 3 out of  5 toilet stalls we tried to use.  Trash cans were over flowing and there was soggy food around all the tables and random areas along thier brick  paths. There was also vomit in several places and then someone pooped in the pool. name: Em Walker
text:
We're locals, so we've been here a few times over the years. That being said, several changes have taken place over the years.

One, the arcade has really taken off, and is actually a really neat place for the kiddos to go - if you don't mind spending an arm and a leg.

Two, it's true, that the water park itself has gotten a bit run down over the years, it was easily noticed when we walked in. I don't think visitors to the hotel would notice as easily upon first glance though.
You can see a few spots in the walls where it apparently needs some TLC and the bottom of the lazy river, has some serious chunks out of it. Overall, it could be worse, but it definitely has been better.

Three, I did see several previous reviewers mention the chlorine. I will say this, we were there for probably close to six hours and my throat began to burn from the amount of it in just the air. After being home for several hours my nose is still burning.

Four, the staff....On the phone several weeks back, they were extremely lackluster and very unhelpful. Today though, they were great! My one son fell and cut his knee open and scratched his ankle up good coming off of one slide. The folks behind the first aid area were awesome, but it didn't escape my attention that they both knew exactly which slide he'd slipped getting out of before we told them. So, I think this must be a regular occurrence.
I did notice that the 'restaurant' staff was extremely short handed for the amount of folks present, only two on staff. Other than that, the entire staff from the front desk gals to the life guards were great.

Five, I did have to agree with some previous reviewers who expresses concern over the alarming lack of life guards on hand. Back in the day, there was one for every exit to the lazy river, two for the big slides - one to allow kids up, and one at the exit of the pool, and one or two walking the Splashground area. The day we visited the kiddie pool was closed for remodeling, but there would've been one or two there as well.
Today though, there was one at the slides, and one at the basketball pool area and they weren't even there the entire time. That was a little concerning considering the amount of people that began to crowd the lazy river, and pool area.

Overall, it was a pretty good trip, and we plan to go back.

name: Keyonna K
text: I love shopping here. The staff are always super friendly and helpful. They have quality produce and fairly priced products. They predominantly store branded products but have some other brands as well depending on the food item. I love their fresh produce and frozen food section because they don't include a bunch of additives and preservatives. With COVID, they work to keep a certain number of customers in the store at one time. Therefore you may have to wait in line a bit before you're allowed to go in depending on the day.

name: Dan DeVetter
text: Great little grocery store. I haven't figured out how to do all of my grocery shopping here but the stuff I do get is great. I joke about quitting my job to come work here because the employees are always so nice and seem to love their jobs.

name: Graham Geyer
text: Selection is great. Having to wait outside in line because of limited number of customers might be an issue in the winter. They did offer waters during the hot months to customers waiting outside. Normally a wait isn't terrible though.

name: Kelly bruner
text: Shoppers go right for the items- fastest shoppers I've seen, I like to read packages, not easily done in a busy place.   I enjoy the flowers and plants, do not hesitate - they sell Quickly !  Loads of ready to eat frozen meals.  No frills,  and a fun selection.  Ohhh  Soo affordable $$$

name: Jeff Kovar
text: Had a short wait outside since they limit the number of customers inside at once. I was there to get only a couple of items. The staff was very nice.

name: Nancy Montenegro
text: Who doesn't love Trader Joe's? The people here are so helpful. I love everything they have. Usually get some fresh cut flowers and orange chicken from their frozen food section.

name: pickles One
text: Staff was friendly.  The stockers were quick and worked around the shoppers.  Prices were accurately marked.

name: Dubblebass Muzik
text: I love this store.  Great produce, superb spices and sauces,, excellent wine selection, and the people are always friendly!

name: Laura Cejka
text: Such a nice store with great, helpful employees. I would really like to see more gluten free options, specifically cake mix.

name: Brian Ward
text: Always find things I didn't go there for but they look to good not to try.

name: Amanda Misemer
text: It was quite busy, but they are taking COVID precautions very seriously and limiting the amount of people in the store at once. The wait was not long at all to get in. It is a little overwhelming for someone who hasn’t been there before but everything we bought has been super tasty and the prices are great too. The staff was very helpful and kind!

name: Liz R
text: Clean and not crowded.  They limit the amount of people in the store at any given time.  Which is nice.

name: bryan murray
text: Trader Joe's is my favorite grocery store and they have all my favorite things. Great staff, great selection, great prices. I just wish they'd bring back those sirloin tacos from summer 2019, I crave them.

name: Jim Bruno
text: Very helpful and friendly staff.  I am now a customer.

name: Michelle Travis
text: I have shopped at this location since it opened and I love it.  This weekend was a a perfect example as to why I shop there.  It was 90+ degrees in the afternoon and while we were waiting to get in, they passed out cold water. That was fantastic customer experience.

name: Stephanie Jones
text: Trader joe's should keep the limited number of people that they have been doing due to COVID all the time. It is a way more pleasant shopping experience. Everything tastes delicious. Excellent wine selection. I spend too much money here.

name: laura petersen
text: Everyone so helpful.  Tried some new things.  Fast checkout.

name: B D
text: Great location. Clean and well maintained. Great option for the health conscious crowd.

name: Mareaeric Campagna
text: I enjoyed Trader Joe's different selections compared to where I normally shop. The cashier & sacker that helped us were especially thoughtful and kind and even gave my grandson 2 large sheets of stuckers.

name: John Schaffert
text: We don't buy a lot of things from Trader Joe's, maybe 20 products or so. But we absolutely LOVE those few items we get there. Prices are great. Staff is always super polite and helpful. The fresh flowers from Trader Joe's are always very nice and an amazing deal.

name: Anonymous Anonymous
text: They think forward.  They are there to help with whatever you need.  They can check you out faster.  They call for more help so you don't have to wait.  Better than most other stores at checkout (shouldn't be hard, but evidently it is).  It doesn't cost so much to get what you need.

name: Megan Page
text: Didn’t visit cause they make their customers stand outside cause of the Pandemic. Like what’s the difference if you all are in line together in the cold when the virus is most app to be strongest or if you are inside the grocery store like any other grocery store. Whoa! I pulled up and laughed and asked the customers in line and they started laughing and they agreed how stupid it was they were standing in line! Trader Joe’s we can do better, can’t we!?

name: Emily Ernst

text: One of a kind finds at Trader Joe’s. Hard to believe they’re owned by Aldi. It’s probably been 20 years since an Aldi visit. Love this place

text: Want to give a shoutout to our local Trader Joe's, who are doing an INCREDIBLE job of making patrons feel safe (... while still getting very, very necessary Trader Joe's goodies.)

text: It’s Trader Joe’s! Always a great experience.

name: Liz Wright
text: Always a great selection and extremely friendly staff

name: Chad K
text:
Decent grocery store with some eclectic choices. They mostly sell their own branded merchandise. People do seem obsessed with the wine here and cart after cart goes out the door with a mixed case of wine bottles in it.

They take forever to ring people up. I think it's a mixture of them using paper bags (which they seem to struggle handling), having a horrible cash register space (no other grocery store has registers designed this way), and a lack of urgency in their employees. If you have a cart full of groceries it's going to take them 10+ minutes to ring you up and bag your stuff.

It's just okay for me. I have to drive past a LOT of other grocery stores to come here and it's just not worth the hassle most times. Sorry, I guess I have yet to "drink the Kool-Aid."

name: Raymond Widtfeldt
text: I have always loved Trader Joe's.  I love their wine selection inventory, and their prices. It's also a great place to find those hard to find, different food products. Great place and really friendly employees.

name: Deb Kubik

name: J T
text:
Trader Joe's. Such a great store, with amazing customer service. You can find a huge variety of products at each store, with amazing seasonal finds.  The seasonings are superb (chili lime and everything but the bagel are favorites at our house!) I also enjoy checking out the beer section, which has findings from location breweries (and changes from location to location).

One fun part of each trader Joe's is the murals and personal touches for each location. The stores use the surrounding locations as an inspiration for murals.

text: We enjoy trader Joe's. They are a smaller grocery store but have good variety of produce and a few unique prepared foods. It is clean and mask required and enforced at this time.

The checker was personable and I told her it was a hard day. She Rang a bell and brought me a bouquet of flowers and explained they give people flowers sometime. It was so sweet.

name: Christina Reed Harvey
text: They’ve re-arranged a bit! All my favorites still available, new packaging on enchiladas. Cashiers are very nice and quick!

name: Lin Brummels

name: Jc k
text: I recently went Vegan because I had high cholesterol and was also diagnosed with prediabetes. My doctor suggested I stay away from meat and sugar. So I went shopping at Trader Joe's and everyone was really nice! Very helpful. They even gave me a printed list of their Vegan foodstuffs. The variety of organic food was amazing! Also fresh produce was very fresh. Everything was reasonably priced. I bought 2 shopping bags full. I can hardly wait to try everything! This is definitely the place for great organic food! I will definitely shop there again! Lots of parking too. And they have the perfect size carts.

name: Andrew Boehm
text: So happy to have Trader Joe’s here in Omaha.  Glad they have amazing fresh flowers.  Brought to a loved one today.

name: Wai Chan
text:
Was very impressed with the level of customer service.
The staff here really seem to go above and beyond, with great pride for their job.
It's always nice to shop where people like working.
They gifted me a bag so I could carry out my groceries (I had gone in originally with no intention to buy). Looking around there were so many options by the time I left my hands were pretty full.
My friend introduced me and explained they have a lot of good products by their own name at very excellent prices. I do concur, that seemed to be the case.
They have an area in the back where they do food combinations that you can sample. You can draw inspiration there.
I was also told if you want to try anything they'll pretty much let you. It's really perfect for someone like me.
Do try their cauliflower gnocchi if you want a lower carb but still pillowy soft option.

Of course, we found several other things here, many things less expensive and better quality than any other grocer. Trader Joe's is a relatively small store, but wow, what a great place.

name: Joshua Barker

Maybe I'll go back when they settle down. Right now it's like going through TSA except it's outside. The line is a joke. UPDATE covid is done. They're still acting like people dying from grocery stores.

I asked if it was good and he responded "My favorite!" the smile never left his face. Delightful? Absolutely! And he was right. Delicious! Now my favorite, and favorite store too.

name: IAmThatStrange Really
text:
Traider Joe's is wonderful.  Is everything 100% perfect?  No - is any other grocery store perfect... No.  Is Traider Joe's better than other stores Yes!  Obviously they do not carry everything everyone needs but can you get foreign food easily from all the general grocery stores?  No.  There are foreign grocery stores but they don't carry such a wide variety of new and interesting stuff to try and end up loving.

On top of all of this is the fact that they carry a lot of vegan based foods.  Not just veggies (which all stores carry) but other foods that are good to keep for those days you don't have time to fix lunch or dinner.  And to say they are tasty!  Wow, everything I've bought there has been wonderful.

The only thing I really wish is that they had more stores...

text:
Clean and friendly with an assumed new employee made sandwiches in the subway and I was not impressed. Ordered footlong steak and cheese and footlong meatball marinara.
Steak was so thin I could see bread through the meat and it had plain bread at both ends. Asked to have more put on, which was done but when rang through was charged for double meat.
Talked to another employee about it and was told the amount used is the standard. My family likes subway and eats their on the average, approximately 3x per month and this sandwich is a favorite. Never had this problem and have never paid double meat. This experience will adjust our eating frequency because I feel the sandwich price are higher than necessary to begin with.

name: Aaron Flores
text: An absolute icon of Nebraska football as well as the State of Nebraska in general. In the off season this is still a lovey venue. Tucked away in downtown Lincoln, you will find a short trip away from almost anywhere in the city. On game days the atmosphere is electric. The Husker faithful show why this stadium holds the sellout record. It’s not everyday one gets to experience Husker game day, so if you get the chance, soak it up all the way!

name: Norman Kromberg
text: If you are a college football fan, you need to attend a game in Lincoln.  The fans are amazing and take pride it welcoming the other team.  It is located close to downtown Lincoln so there are options to traditional tailgating.  This is an old school stadium.  I do recommend getting the seats because of the bench’s.  It gets tight.  Go Big Red.

name: joel fritz
text: Great college football atmosphere,  fans are friendly and it's easy to get around. There is one of the largest big screens in the country on the north end. The sound system and light is excellent.  The Huskers attract a large crowd its home of the longest sell out streak in college football.

name: P C
text: Greatest football stadium in the world. Greatest fans in the world. Greatest game-day atmosphere in the world. Must see in college football. Won't be disappointed. You'll love it and want your son to play there.

name: Daniel Griffith
text: I love this place. Great environment to be in on game day. The fans have gotten a little less courteous over the years, but still very football and game situation smart! I highly recommend seeing a game here if you have never been here, even if you're an away team fan. You'll still be treated nicely and with respect. Go Big Red!!!

name: Jeremy Borakove
text: Go Big Red!!. I have never lived in a state without 4 or 5 professional teams, so this is a completely new experience for me.  Its amazing how quiet the city gets on Saturday, and how on Monday if the Huskers lose, you can't even talk to most folks.  Proud to become a proud member of Corn Nation

name: Chris Fowler
text: Great facility rich in history!  Its an awesome place to watch a football game.  GBR!!

name: Becky Bruns
text: Wow!! What else can you say... the facility is well maintained and is used for more than just football games... there's just something about that stadium that makes you feel excited. Was the perfect place to host the finish to the Lincoln Half Marathon.

name: Ginny Shueey
text: Go Big Red!!! The stadium is a fun place. Go to your assigned gate and follow the sea of red.

name: Richard Ratzburg
text: My favorite place on Earth! Go Big Red! Daughter on the Bass line for the Husker marching band! We dressed for the cold, and it was cold and the wind was blowing and the snow was wonderous! Best of all, the Huskers won!!!

name: Christina Marie
text: What else can I say except GO BIG RED?! Amazing atmosphere. I love the updates to the stadium. Great food (credit cards accepted).  Can’t beat it!!

name: Eric Miller
text: best place in the country...game day is spectacular

name: Colette Siner
text: GO BIG RED! Memorial stadium is such an energetic and fun place to watch college football! The security and other staff are always friendly & efficient. Pretty decent food options with some fun Nebraska Staples, runza sandwiches and Valentino's pizza!

name: Marvin
text: Yesterday was my first time sitting in Memorial Stadium, and I can say that it's a really fun experience!  I especially enjoyed the marching band; they have an incredible sound!  They produce a synergy that radiates all around the stadium.  Overall, I enjoy the open-air feel of the stadium, and even when things start to get crowded, seating is still comfortable.  It's no surprise that Memorial Stadium has a reputation for consecutively sold-out games.  Wonderful experience!

name: Marcella Donner
text: What a great experience going to a Husker game even though the temperatures were very cold the fans around us were absolutely wonderful. We sat in the endzone and had great seats, awesome views!

name: Chris Beining
text: First time for me and was a pretty good experience. Was there with my lady who is a Husker Fan and me I am from Wisconsin so go Badgers. 37-21 Badgers awesome. Was in section 32 row 98 way way up and would have been nice except for the 20mph wind blowing right in our direction. Loved the stadium and the prices for things very reasonable compared to other stadiums that's for sure. Will definitely be going again.

name: Becky Hundley
text: Always a great time!🏈 ❤ The view from Section 4 Row 34 Seat 8.

name: Debra Reddy
text: Beautiful stadium...great tour for my daughter's 4th grade class.

name: Bugndoll
text: There's no place like it. ❤️

name: Zach Herr
text: Wonderful experience. Delicious pizza, top notch. Comfy seat. Runzas were good. The Huskers played football. Friendly people except that one guy that told me to get the f out of the way on the stairs.

name: Anton Engel
text: Best place to watch College Football!

name: Erick Matzke
text: Great Fun. Really enjoyed the game, even though it was bone chilling COLD.

name: Jamie
text: Such an amazing experience! Everyone was decently priced!

name: Michael Neeley
text: There is No Place like Nebraska, and there is No Place in Nebraska like Memorial Stadium on game day!

name: Todd Freeburg
text: It was fun. I haven't been there since high school in the 70s. They have done a lot of upgrading like things to keep interest between plays and time outs. The best part is where my three children and I got to go watch the game together

name: Charlie Gray
text: What can I say. It was top notch!

name: Eric Case
text: Always a great timr. GO BIG RED

name: Judy Glathar
text: Great game, super Skybox, we won.

name: Aaron Cole
text: Great stadium, great fans, and always a good time.  Will definitely be going back to see the huskers!

name: Ian
text: Probably one of the best atmospheres to watch football!

name: OJ Utter
text: Love this place! The improvements that have been made have made it so much more accessible for handicapped people. The environment on game day is like none other. Love the band, the video boards, the Swiener Slinger, & all the pagentry that goes along with Husker games

name: Joe Holm
text: Very nice staff took our group on an inside tour, really appreciate their time and the effort they put into it

name: Jolly Ann Marine
text: Great atmosphere, great people and a great team.

name: Matt Scheitle
text:
GO BIG RED!!!!

Great facility for Game Day! Atmosphere and staff are great!!! Also State Football plays here and it’s an beacon for the state to come here and watch their favorite teams play!

name: Jose Matamoros
text: Wonderful stadium with a great spirit.

name: Aaron Engel
text: I got used to the atmosphere here, no better place to watch a game in my opinion. After visiting other stadiums for top 10 matchups, Memorial Stadium is still the best experience any weekend of the year.

name: Carmen L. Throckmorton
text: The most friendly fans you'll ever meet!!!

name: Dan Cottrell
text: Always a great time! Top notch venue!

name: Travis Collins
text: We love watching the football games here as a family! The atmosphere on game day Saturday’s is amazing.

name: Don Coates
text: What a great place to go to watch the Nebraska Huskers play some College Football. It’s an experience all Husker fans should have a chance to enjoy.

name: Jennifer Burrous
text: Awesome time I'm so in love with the huskeers now..im hooked.i was rised in ga,have a dad that is a Clemson #fan. But my brother has always loved the huskeers since we were little..hope to take him to a game one day!!!!

name: Shana Warner
text: The BEST college stadium in the US!!

name: Jeff Sis
text: Best college football stadium in the NCAA!

name: Kim Herek
text: Best place for college football!

name: Talon Ramsey
text: The atmosphere is electric and even though we were up in the top section (605) of the stadium, we still had a great, unobstructed view of the action on field.

name: Angelica Hitchcock
text: When attending the game it is a full on experience. Lots of vending including Runza, Valentino's, and hot dogs that are sold at your seat. Huge place but has people who can direct you. Definitely a fun time, even if your team loses!

name: Jon Paladino
text: What can you say about Memorial Stadium and Tom Osborne field?  Classic.  In the deed the glory.  Lots of history here, blending the new and the old.  The mushroom track may be gone, but the columns outside, the trophies inside, all testify to the important place this stadium holds in the state of Nebraska.

name: Stephanie H
text: We got tickets in the 600 row this year and we had our own escalators all the way up.the 600 row of seats have their own concession stands and bathroom so not nearly as crowded or as long as limes as down below. Seats were not crowded and we had a terrific view of the whole field.

name: Husker Nation
text: Very good atmosphere because of the fan base, regardless if the Huskers win or lose.

name: Matthew Stevison
text: Did some work out here

name: Little Bear
text: Great atmosphere, great fans, great food. What more can you ask for? Goooo Big RED!!!!

name: Eddie Sempek
text: Wish the pizza was available past the 1st half. Great place. Not a bad seat and easy to navigate

name: Edgar Mateo Joaquin
text: Awesome game experience! Even though we had nosebleed tickets. GO Big Red!

name: Ashley Janssen
text: Obviously being from Nebraska this is a holy place for me. Nicest fans in all of college football all gathered in one place. Can't get any better than that. GBR! ❤️

name: Abby Urbanek
text: I love coming to games here. The food and drinks are reasonably priced, great view from anywhere you sit and the fans are always amazing.

name: Trucker Dude101
text: Been a husker fan all my life, I make husker games whenever I can, it's always an awesome experience for my family and i!

name: Gini Marie
text: Great place with several novelty shops, a museum, special events and offers. It was even better because my favorite team won!

name: Monty Barbee
text: Never a bad time at Husker stadium

name: Samantha Taylor
text: What's not to love...if you're a Husker fan. If you haven't experienced a tour, you should try it sometime.

name: Korey Wells
text: Go Big Red!

name: Kellie Piersee
text: Tour of facility & stadium. Beautiful and awe inspiring!

name: Mike Davis
text: Great day, sad loss for Nebraska.

name: Jack Cudaback
text: Met one of my best college buddies here for a Husker game after not seeing him for 15 years it was an awesome time. Mac passed away a few weeks ago, great to see him again. Great times.

name: Justin S
text: If you like nebraska football you need to come to one game.

name: C W
text: There is no better college football atmosphere than Memorial Stadium.... GO BIG RED!!

name: Ken Lantz
text: A classic staple of the grand tradition of our state. My fall home.

name: Doug Warner
text: Awesome venue with lots of great tradition!!

name: Nicole K
text: Beautiful stadium. Go Big Red!!

name: Chris Sempek
text: Awesome time!

name: Antonia Mendez
text: Love going to Husker games!!!! Clear bag policy in place here as with most stadiums now. Only certain sizes allowed, but I was able to bring my clear back pack in. I just had to take everything out and they checked everything but were very nice and polite about it! You can buy some bottle pop's but it's Pepsi products, otherwise you get a pop with no lid or straw in a cup.They only serve hamburger pizza here for some reason too? But I love the football games here!!!

name: Melissa Wentworth
text: Love the stadium. Love the team. I am a fan for life! GBR!

name: Alexie L. Herrmann
text: It's absolutely beautiful. I wish it would have been easier to get to our seats from the medical device check gate. Make sure to check out the Red Cross station. They have a nursing room and free hydration. Overall limited food options for any dietary restrictions.

name: Russell Leier
text: Home of the Huskers.  Atmosphere is always electric.  It is an old building, and shows in spots, but the upgrades over the years have kept it up to speed with other stadiums.   Venders are constantly walking the aisles so you do not have to miss any action going to get a snack or drink.  The big down side is they serve pepsi products now.  Bring back Coke!

name: Jakob Heyde
text:
Go Big Red Stadium..

Gigantic

name: Matt
text: Quite simply the greatest Saturday College Football experience. I've be n coming since I was a kid. A must attend bucket list for any football fan. Can't wait until the Huskers get back to some form of glory and the old stadium can rock and roll like it used to back in the day.

name: Thomas Wuestewald
text: If you are a Husker fan this is the holy land. There is no better place to watch a football game, and our fans are the most welcoming and amazing people.

name: Scott Morrill
text: Great stadium, nice atmosphere

name: Mattie Webben
text: Great experience but will never pay $5 for hot chocolate

name: Scott Smith
text: Very exciting! A great time watching the HUSKER band. Ready for the upcoming Football season. GO BIG RED!!!

name: Sharon Scotton
text: Home of the greatest team, greatest fans and super nice staff!

name: Randall Philippi
text: Best place in the world to watch a college football game. The crowd and the atmosphere are second to none. Get your pretzels early as they run out quick.

name: Michelle Mauer
text: Great time....we love coming to cheer on our Huskers!  :)

name: Steve Sindel
text: Great atmosphere great people great football! Nebraska strong

name: Nick James
text: BEST  Stadium in the country. Beautiful nostalgic, traditional. Oh yeah home of the greatest football team in the country as well with the greatest fans .go big red!  Oh yeah we just added the greatest coach in college football. Just when you thought this place couldn't get any greater.

name: Laura Millhouse
text: Memorial stadium is one of my favorite places to visit! The tours are excellent and especially loved by my children. Gameday is a once-in-a-lifetime experience for any Husker fan and I am blessed to be a part of the sea of red! GBR!

name: Diana Grubb
text: Home to the Huskers, the greatest fans on earth! A great experience all around.  Good food, band, facilities, and a great football program.  Be sure to come early enough to see the flyover....it is the best!

name: Dan D
text: Best stadium in the nation, with the best fans in college football! Get there early and head down under the North stadium to watch the tunnel walk! Definitely is an awesome experience!  But if you cant make it, definitely be in your seat 15-20min. Before kickoff to watch the flyover, and the presentation on the big screen! It will get you pretty hyped for the game!

name: Doug Michalak
text: Love it! My son had a blast at his first game!

name: Mike Egger
text: Huskers Vs Badgers!  Great game day experience, unfortunately the result was not what I wanted.

name: Douglas Clark
text: Best college atmosphere in College Football. 90,000 dedicated Cornhusker fans.

name: susan larsen
text: Best fans in the world. Go big red!

name: James VanCura
text: It was a great game

name: Kevin KEITH
text: Nice stadium good facilities pretty place bad team lol

name: Steve Henk
text: It's an awesome & inspiring place.  The University Marching Band is absolutely fantastic.

name: Bob Condello
text: Always a great time...even when we lose and lately we almost always do.

name: Roy Ewoldt
text: Only a few things makes my hair stand on end. Pure excitement

name: Jimmy
text: Love the energy anytime you set foot in the stadium.

name: Carol Copeland
text: Electrifying in Every Way.  Nebraska traditions will be enjoyable to any one who comes inside the stadium!

name: Anthony Wagner
text: Best place in the world!

name: Richard Albergucci
text: Sky box balling! Whole different view up here, awesome!

name: ykk one
text: Great atmosphere and Nebraska Football Team is doing better than usual.

name: Steven White
text: Historic and iconic football  stadium.  One of the best venues in the country to watch a college  football  game.

name: Susy McMahan
text: Go Big Red!  You have to see it on a football Saturday.

name: Leon Widhalm
text: One of the Greatest places to see a college football game.  An on campus stadium.  Enjoy the nice walk through campus and enjoy the best fans in college football.  GBR!

name: Mark Honnor
text: Season ticket holder. Always a great time.

name: C. Todd Cook
text: Great place to watch some college football! Great atmosphere! Great, knowledgeable crowd!

name: alaska 68752
text: We had great seats. Be prepared to pay extra for anything extra you want. The seats are so close together be prepared to stay seated until half time, because there is no room to get up and leave once seated.

name: Dillon Vestecka
text:
Amazing stadium. Compared to many other stadiums, they have people walking the stands selling concessions, instead of having to go to a stand, like Michigan's stadium.
Nebraska has the best fans in college football too!  Very friendly people.  Overall great experience l.

name: Donald Sousek
text: Call me a homer for saying this, I don't care. Love this place. Get here in time to experience the Tunnel Walk and cheer for your team. Keep it as positive as possible so we can still call ourselves the greatest fans in the country. Go Big Red and Go Huskers.

name: Renae Mack
text: If you have never been to a game here, plan to go! The energy is amazing! I always have a blast.

name: T. STILES
text:
Memorial Stadium was built in 1923 at a cost of $450,000 with a capacity of 31,080. The first game at the new stadium was a 24–0 Nebraska victory over Oklahoma on October 13, 1923.

A series of expansions has brought the stadium's current capacity to 85,458, but attendance numbers regularly exceed 90,000. Nebraska has sold out an NCAA-record consecutive games at Memorial Stadium, an ongoing streak that dates back to 1962. When full, Memorial Stadium holds more people than all but two Nebraska cities (Omaha and Lincoln).

A statue of former head coach Tom Osborne and former quarterback Brook Berringer stands at the main entrance of the Osborne Athletic Complex on the north side of the stadium. Berringer, a native Nebraskan and backup quarterback on Nebraska's 1994 and 1995 national championship-winning teams, died in a plane crash on April 18, 1996, just two days before the '96 NFL Draft. He was projected to be an early- to mid-round pick.

In 2013, a statue of former head coach Bob Devaney was unveiled at the entrance of the newly renovated east stadium, just before Nebraska's season opener against Wyoming. Nebraska and Wyoming were the only two schools Devaney served as a head coach at the collegiate level.

The record attendance as of right now is 91,585 from September 20, 2014 when Nebraska beat Miami 31 - 41.

text: It's a good experience to go to a game and experience the crowd. But seats are very narrow and not very well defined. I would suggest the seats they sell so people don't take over your seat territory. Food is consistent in price with stadium food. They have Val's pizza, Runzas, popcorn, hot dogs and polish dogs as the main food. There are also lots of specialty stands. Make sure to get the wrist bands for small children that have the seat location and parent phone number on it. Children become separated from parents regularly. I would also suggest bussing in as you are dropped off at the staduim and it is cheaper than parking.

name: Todd Hohbein
text: If you fondly remember the roadside oddities and tourist stops of the 60s-70's, then you will love this place. One of the last true large examples of roadside Americana. HUGE selection of cowboy/Indian themed souvenirs at fair to moderate prices. Look for the barely marked door that takes you out back to the fun outdoor displays, including a classic 'Muffler Man' transformed into an Indian. So much to see and do here. Absolute must-see.

resp.text: Wow Todd!!!    Thank you for such a nice review!    You GET us, and that makes us so happy!!!!

text:
This is definitely a tourist stop!  But kids will LOVE it!  Stop in and learn a little bit about the area.

Not only do they have shirts and games and candies and toys for kids they also have some authentic Native American gear, and my favorite part, the historical book selection they have about Nebraska, the West, and the history that built the area.  Best selection you can find in one place.

Stop in if you're just driving through!

resp.text: Alyssa, I'm so sorry you thought we were stale.  This is our 51st year in this location and every year we are constantly trying new merchandise to keep things fresh.  In the last few years we have significantly added more food products for shoppers to enjoy.  Our Native American Jewelry has grown from just Turquoise and Coral to dozens of different stones found all over the world.  Our summer concerts are a new attraction that brings in a ton of local people every Thursday night.  Give us another try sometime!

name: John Potter
text: Food great! I loved the chips and salsa and our food truly was fabulous. But the Service was abysmal. Which reflects in this score. Our waitress didn’t even know or was informed she was serving us. We waited 20 minutes just to see someone. She wasn’t even an waitress, she was the barista. Must be understaffed. I felt bad she had like 12 people to tend to as well as wait our table because the hostess gave her a table to wait (us) as well. Obviously she wouldn’t be able to give us stellar service. Just was disappointed we didn’t have an actual waitress, and had to wait way too long. Also The parking in the parking garage right next door is NOT free, just FYI for those thinking is it for customers here.

resp.text: Hi John, Thanks for sharing your feedback with us. I'm so happy to hear you loved your food, but I'm terribly sorry about the extended wait and lackluster service you received on your recent visit! I'd like to learn a few additional details. Will you please email me directly at Amy@FRG.rest? Kindly, Amy

name: Logemann Wissanee
text: Food is delicious and the place are nice. I think they're a little bit pricey but again it down town.  I only compare food and price, feel like higher then I thought. It three of us and the bill in picture,it just only food for one. I cut one star because is almost hour and half waited for the food.

name: Momma & Papa Behr
text: Friendly Service, great atmosphere, especially for open summer seating; but, they're missing the military discount program.

name: estirbune
text:
Tried the new vegan options tonight... Not only was it yummy but it was so nice not having more than just a few options to choose from! I went with the Tex-Mex tacos with the vegan chick'n. I added fresh jalapeno and a margarita... Meal was served quickly - which is always a plus when you're hungry! We walked out full!  Thoroughly pleased!

Came back and caught the vegan tacos on happy hour!!!

name: Josh Irish
text: Really good fajitas. Only down side our server was taking care of her bar people and didnt check on us that much, because she was always making a different drink for another table. But the manager check on us quite a bit and that was nice.

name: Jean Cappellano
text: Margheritas are excellent  Food is good , like the hours for Happy Hour 3pm is a good time to go.

name: Kishia Montalvo
text:
Omg, best House Margarita! Yummy...I can't wait to try more!!!
The chips and salsa are so good and could almost be enough lol...but seriously the food is delicious!! I recommend trying this place if you haven't already!!

name: Trevor J. Sandidge
text:
Roja never fails to disappoint. Always fast service and the red accent lighting creates a great atmosphere for fun.

I rave over their Tex Mex Tacos and anything from the Enchilada menu. Portion sizes are large, so bring your appetite! They also bring out free chips and salsa, so I always enjoy just getting drinks and eating chips!

One of my favorite downtown restaurants and honestly one of the best Tex Mex in Omaha!

name: Dustin J
text: Delicious food great atmosphere I hope they make their way back to open.

name: Kristina Young
text: Love the patio! Tacos are pretty good too!

resp.text: Thank you, Kristina!

name: Jessica Chatman
text: Roja is always fun. It doesn't matter what day or time of day. Margaritas are delicious, food is awesome, and the staff is always ready to have some fun. I.have never had a less than stellar visit at the Downtown location. And I've never had to wait more than 15 minutes for a table. And that one time was a holiday Saturday with no reservation.

name: John Ashford
text: Roja was opened off the momentum of Blue Sushi (5 stars!) and other Flagship projects and was really cutting edge at the time.  Over the years the service isn't quite what it used to be, its showing its age  and is not as clean especially after heavy weekend drinking nights in the Summer.  Good lunch menu and they can move you in and out quickly.  Also, great happy hour.  Solid middle of the road restaurant downtown.

name: Jade Drost
text: Absolutely loved this restaurant. Excellent server-Jenna. Very attentive but didn't hover. Came at lunch and had a house Margarita and smothered pork burrito. Both were excellent. This will be my go to for Mexican anytime I'm in Omaha from now on

name: Monika Solanki
text: This is my one of the favorite places to eat dinner in old market. They have really good veggie fajitas and vegan chicken tacos. Must try.

name: shawntae lett
text: Very laid-back atmosphere on a Saturday night.  Food and drinks was also a excellent choice.  Can sit outside and enjoy your drinks and friends.  Will definitely be going back.

name: Wai Chan
text: Had this platter. Very good food. Service was absent at times. Would still go back though.

name: Alex Hart
text: Good food, decent service. Upscale feeling American/Mexican restaurant. Very loud, but of course I visited on a Saturday night when they were busy

name: James Stahlecker
text: Trendy place, great outdoor patio, large bar with lots of great drink options.  Great for dinner for two or larger groups.

name: Frederick A Collins Jr
text: Hit the spot! Food was quick,  margaritas were amazing, and the staff was great.  We felt at home 🏡 although COVID has affected the restaurant business tremendously.

name: Patrick McCracken
text: Went and tried the hatch chili menu, well worth it. The stuffed chilli's are great and the soup good to the last drop

name: Zach M
text: Great food, quick service, good portion sizes. If you like Tex-Mex this is the best spot in Downtown.

name: Justin Brakebill
text: Good food and service

name: jamie chadd
text: Roja is one of my favorites in the city - love their sampler platter and mojitos - give the jalapeno margarita a try at least once.  The atmosphere is a great fit for date night OR taking the kids out for dinner!  Excellent location.

name: Abbey Jackson
text: Roja is perfect for happy hour - great margs and appetizers, and a fun atmosphere.  But their food is just mediocre.  I've tried it (sober) several times and I am always underwhelmed.  I'm sure I'll keep going to with other people, but it's never my first choice.

name: Danielle H
text: First time and Roja!! The margarita's were delicious!!! Ordered the Stacked Shrimp Enchilada and the flavors were AMAZING!!!!! Definitely can't wait to try another item off the menu!

name: Dustin Hedges
text: One of my favorites. Great atmosphere and the food is always delicious. Can't go wrong!

name: Greg Klaus
text: Had a quick business lunch with my manager. A young man was our server. Was very good and quick! Wasn't intrusive but made sure we were doing well. Food was great and served in less than 10 minutes after we ordered. Was going to leave positive feedback with the restaurant manager about our ser ER but had to leave quickly for a meeting.

name: ryan neemeyer
text: Love the happy hour!!! Come in every few weeks. Staff is always great. Great outdoor seating. Margaritas are good.

name: Meagan Cooper
text: Rainy night but customer service shined bright. Thanks for your help and great conversation. Short wait for carry out. Clean restaurant, closes at 11pm.

name: Shelley Sandmaier
text: The chips are awesome and the food is great! Perfectly hot enough, but not too spicy for an amateur like me!

name: Queen Mom
text: The food was ok, the atmosphere was dark and creepish, maybe because they sat us in the back like they were hiding us

resp.text:
Hi,
I'm sorry to hear this.  I don't ever want any of our guest's to feel like we've "hidden them".  I'd love to learn a bit more from you so that we can address any shortcomings in-house.
If you'd be so kind, my email is Ryan@FRG.rest
I do hope to hear back from you.
Kindly,
Ryan w/ Flagship Restaurant Group

name: Karen
text: I had a strawberry margarita which was very good. The chips and salsa are great. I loved that they had gf choices, but the shrimp was a little chewy. My brother and sister shared the chicken/steak fajitas and the steak was full of grizzle.

name: Stephanie Simpson
text: They were able to get is in really quickly when it was really busy. Service was excellent.

name: Bryan Stickney
text: Yummy food here!

name: Bobby Blair
text: Great food! Great service! Food was served very fast.

name: Zez Wehz
text: One of the best Mexican places in Omaha. Highly recommend for Vegans or Vegetarians

name: Bert Simoens
text: It was mom's choice to share a meal with the whole family back in town for Christmas.  LOVE my Flagship family and love the stacked shrimp enchiladas and the chips and salsa are addictive!!!!

name: Summer R
text: I asked for ketchup for my tacos I ordered here and they brought me out this.. Like what is this i was gonna use the ketchup to share with my son and this is what they gave me there is no sharing this!! I would only stop in here if you like selective music and bad service they think your gonna steal a ketchup bottle when you show up in a dress and your son shows up in a suit.. I don't advise this place.

resp.text: Thank you for your feedback. We'd like the opportunity to learn more about your visit and have you visit us again. Kindly email me: laddan.abbasi@frg.rest

name: Steven White
text: Rojas rarely disappoints (except when they dropped  Coors Light from their happy hour specials)  The food is always solid and decently  priced.  Service at the bar always efficient and friendly.  We enjoy  going here during happy hour prior to shows at the Holland or Orpheum.  Would recommend

name: Mandy Blackburn
text: This is my 2nd time here. My first was a disaster due to poor service. After writing a bad review the company contacted me and asked to make it up. Today we have it a shot and holy only night and day. The drinks were perfect. Food was out on a Sat night in 20 min. Hot and delicious. Order was perfect. Waitress was wonderful. They definitely redeemed themselves and we will be back.

name: Patrick Harlan
text: Had the taco salad with fajita chicken.  It was really good.  The service was great too.

name: Eric Burns
text: Great place for groups. Quick service and love the happy hour.

name: kathy britenstine-salavec
text: It is much better this week the last week our bartender faith is very kind and very courteous and very understanding thank you very much

name: Romas Mitchell
text: It was a pleasant place. The fresh chips and salsa were great. On the downside my server disappeared for a good 20 minutes with even take my order. When I finally go food it was really good.

name: Cory Cashatt
text: Great food. and the waiter was cute. :)

name: Andi Ackley
text: Always the best food and Service! This is one of our fav places to eat!

name: DC Closeouts Wholesale
text: Had a great time. Great food

resp.text: Hi there, I'm pleased to hear you had a great time dining with us! I'd love to learn how we might be able to earn back those last 2 stars. Would you mind emailing me at Amy@FRG.rest? Kindly, Amy

name: Nikki Marquez
text: Love their chips and salsa! Had the Mahi Mahi tacos and they were also pretty tasty. Our waiter, Miguel, was top notch! Very attentive, but not annoying, and he handled the goofy group I was in very well. Even brought out a cup of applesauce for my little baby! MIGUEL should be running things there!

name: Dawn Andersen
text: We had a party of 16 for my parents anniversary on Valentines Day. Age ranging from 3-84. Our waiter John was AMAZING! He was personable and patient. Our glasses were never empty, nor were our tortilla chip baskets. Our food was served fast and hot-not 1 complaint from the group. The prices were very reasonable. Rojas let us bring in a cake and brought out extra plates and silverware. I highly recommend this establishment.

name: john smith
text: Great food, awesome prices at happy hour. Great place.

name: Shandelle G
text: Awesome restaurant with a cool atmosphere. Perfect location. Great menu, friendly staff, wonderful food!

name: Teri Andersen
text: Food was good, it was a little pricey.

name: Dana Taylor
text: A good well cooked meal. It looked good, tasted good, and went down well with a Corona. The mail came out pretty quick also. The portion was just right. The waiter spilled my Taco on my lap, but that's okay. He gave me another taco and a free Corona. The place is clean and the atmosphere is nice. Plus, it's downtown, and there's plenty of women to look at, if you're single.

name: cm mora
text: Literally one of the best steak fajitas I've ever had! And I've had some real authentic food elsewhere. They always cook the meat to perfection hands down. But they are a little pricey and stingy with the tortillas they'll cost extra ..but the food is great so worth it! However, sometimes the service is lacking and other time the service is great. I guess it depends on the day. But you won't be disappointed.

name: Ryan *Torqueman* Hammond
text:
Very good food & drinks as usual.
Were downtown for an event & remembered Roja! As stated the food & drinks are great!
I cannot say it isn't worth it. However I cannot justify $100 for 4 margaritas & dinner with an appetizer for 2 people.
I understand rent & food costs... but $100 for 2 people's dinner is just a treat!
Even with the prices it may be 4.5 stars!

name: Muhammed Rasheduzzaman
text: We had a team outing and we went there for a lunch. The restaurant is very clean and decent and the staffs are very welcoming and very friendly. They took long time to serve our order and as a customer satisfaction they didn't charge for our three dishes. The first time we were bit disappointed but thanks to the team to compensate the issue.

name: Jamms 4
text: Love this place. Always busy, but definitely know why. Food is delicious. Margaritas are amazing!

name: Mike Heitzman
text: Very good food and great service

name: Mike Brodbeck
text: Great food. The service was good and the atmosphere was nice. Looked like they had good daily food and drink specials as well. I'd recommend stopping by.

name: Dave Frazier
text: Service is great, food is delicious, restaurant is clean and actually comfortable even with large lunch crowds...also there's outside seating.  It's Tex-Mex so if you're expecting authentic Mexican cuisine you'll be disappointed.  Prices are a bit on the expensive side though I guess it's about right for a big city.

name: Mark Kemmerer
text: Bartenders and management are amazing! Tacos are the best in town! Love this place!

name: Laura Betz
text: Was pleasantly surprised because the person we were with didn't love it the first time. We all loved it this time and got huge plates. The vegan options were awesome!

name: Christopher Gilpin
text: Excellent as always. Highly recommend

name: Jenny Holling
text: Steak fajitas are Great! They grill a fresh jalapeno with every plate. Verde salsa is yummy, we like to request all the sauces. Be prepared for the spicy habanero, a little goes along way! Excellent margaritas!!

name: Mr. Whiskers
text:
Of course there are a lot of choices of places to eat in Old Market but Roja Mexican Grill would be my choice in the area.

We both enjoyed our meal, chips and salsa appetizer and sitting outside made it a most enjoyable lunch while visiting Old Market

name: Bob LeBaugh
text: Great place for happy hour or a meal

name: Jacob Fedorchik
text: Roja is a great place to eat at! Their food is exceptional and the staff is great. I had a few misunderstandings with my order but the waitress was quick to resolve them. I would recommend the tacos and Margaritas!

name: Shawn McGrath
text: Good tex mex food I had the surf and turf tacos and they were great!

name: Raymond Widtfeldt
text: Great place for Mexican food in the Old Market area.

name: Sean H
text: Some of the best tex mex in Omaha.  I enjoy the enchiladas and rice.

name: Ben Kirkland
text: Highly recommend for get togethers (note they won't seat you until the entire party has arrived). The food is great, the drinks are great, the atmosphere isn't necessary "Mexican" but it's clean and aesthetically pleasing. If you are hesitant go during $1 taco Tuesday and you'll be hooked.

name: Carman Johnson
text: Great food and friendly staff

name: Max Ann Castater
text: We were looking for a place to eat, out late. We decided to try downtown Omaha. It was just around 11pm, Sunday, March 26th. We were seated quickly, and in a perfect spot. Love the decor and ambiance. Our server, Erin, was very friendly and genuine! Our food was delicious, and the chips and salsa while we waited for our meal were good, too. I had the nachos, which are different from traditional nachos, they were very unique, but certainly tasty! She was very friendly from start to finish and had good timing. My boyfriend got tacos, they were fantastic. We finished off with a small fried ice cream that we shared, which I highly recommend. The bill was much cheaper than I expected, for all the food we got, which was an added bonus! However we didn't get any alcoholic beverages, which also helps in that department. Fantastic service, Erin!

name: Kevin Henry
text: Great downtown location. There's a parking garage next door which is convenient

name: Wendy
text: Amazing Food, Amazing Service

name: Jim W
text: Food was excellent and service even better! Really good Mexican.

name: Joyce Lange
text: Great appetizers.  Chips were hot. The pomegranate margarita was very good.

name: Shelley Molck
text: Their margarita are good , their chips are light and crispy

name: Mike Hendricks
text: This is one authentic Mexican place! My wife really loves it here, its her comfort food, and now I know how to put her in a good mood! I was also impressed by how good the dishes were. Highly recommended

name: Chris Clark
text: Good location and usually a fun staff.

name: Becky Alexander
text: We had an awesome lunch here, food was delicious!

name: think about it
text: Good crispy corn tacos I enjoyed them service was nice helpful and attentive. We'll be back of course! Thanks to all the helpful staff as well!

name: Katherine Hicks
text: Fajitas on Wednesdays are not worth it.  I could do a better job at home.  My silverware was dirty and my waitress at the time had a smug attitude.  This is why I don't eat Tex-mex.

resp.text: Hi Katherine, I'm so sorry to hear we weren't able to impress you more overall and would like to learn some additional details. Please email me directly at Amy@FRG.rest. Kindly, Amy

name: Josh Walsh
text: Food was decent, but for having "the best margarita in Omaha" I was highly dissatisfied with the one I ordered.

resp.text: Hey Josh, While I'm happy to hear you enjoyed your food, I'm bummed you weren't more impressed with your margarita! I'd love to learn a bit more about your visit or any recommendations you might have on how we can improve for next time. Please email me at Amy@FRG.rest. Kindly, Amy

name: Margaret Cooter
text: Very tasty food, friendly service, and cool atmosphere -- a bit edgy but still comfortable. The menu is the same -- recognizably Mexican dishes done with flare. Good vegetarian options, too.

name: Stacey Coleman
text: Always enjoy happy hour there...recommend the Roja Sangria and the Pulled Pork Sopes!!

name: I'm Just Vita
text: Nice environment.   However,  my friends and I went to have a girls night and we were there at the end of happy hour.  Yet we were charged regular prices.  The waitress never stated the specific on what to order.   The food was not all that well for the ridiculous price.. The margarita tasted like a slushy I could have gotten at a gas station.  Not worth the price. I will not ever return.   The visit was my first and last.

name: Joseph Kenney
text: Local Omaha product that serves a consistently good product. The most authentic? No, but they don’t advertise that either. If you’re seeking good Mexican food in a fun environment then give one of their two locations a shot.

name: Jim Gawrych

text: I went to this place today and really received less than expected service. When I went in the host was busy with a couple in front of me. Yes I was alone. Once the host returned he assumed I was with another party that walked in behind me. Finally he asked if I was with them. I said NO and asked if I could have a table. He said the bar was open seating. I again asked for a table. The place was not busy at all. He again insisted that I sit at a table in the bar. I finally realized that I was a bother to him and sat at a table in the bar. I sat there for 8 and a half minutes before a manager finally came to me(after sending the host on break) and asked if I had been helped. Keep in mind the bartender only had 4 people at the bar who were paying and leaving. I was trying to ask the manager a question about the Salsa sampler and she cut me off. 30 minutes later the waiter(bartender) finally came to take my order. I wanted to ask questions but felt like I was bothering every employee I encountered. Now being a single person in a full service restaurant I realize the stigma implied to single people. I however work in the business and refuse to accept that this is normal and make sure my employees don't treat anyone this way. I think more training and better management can change this restaurant. I will NEVER go back.

resp.text: William, I am extremely sorry to hear about your recent experience with us. We strive to provide only top-notch, friendly and attentive customer service, regardless of party size, and it sounds like we really dropped the ball here. I'd love to investigate this a bit further so that we can get this address and provide additional training where necessary. Will you please email me directly at Amy@FRG.rest?
