name: Sean Ellis
text: From checking in until checkout, my stay here was one of the most comfortable I've experienced in a hotel. This hotel is well appointed with a full kitchen, living area and bedroom. The room(s) were impeccably clean and concierge staff were very pleasant. There's also valet service (which I didn't use) but the attendant and I had a nice conversation. If you enjoy a piece of history, Residence Inn Omaha Downtown happens to be in the original Federal Building built in the 1920's. There are pieces of that history throughout the hotel. The building is on the National Historic Register, so preservation was in place when renovations took place.

name: Jetlover X
text: We were welcomed very nicely and friendly. The hotel is very nice and in a good shape. Room looked also very good. The shower and the whole water system could be a bit stronger (more pressure). Staff was always friendly. The first night was crazy! Some persons hear loud music, but we did not contact the reception as we thought that it was outside. The next day breakfast was good. Bad surprise when we came back after going to the zoo: Room wasn't made (it was 2:30 pm). Complained and room was made quickly. In general the staff was always very nice and polite. I can recommend the hotel and would come back.

resp.text: Carlo, thank you for the great review and rating!

name: casey carr
text: Cool building with interesting history.  Great location.  Valet parking was $15 per day and parking garage is $10.

name: Chad Nabity
text: Great location. Staff was helpful, room was clean and well appointed. Beautiful historic building. Downside was the hallways are noisy and echo into the rooms becuase the could not cover the historic flooring with carpet.

name: Nalleli Zermeno
text: One of my favorite hotels in Omaha. Great people and amazing rooms

name: Mini Romero
text: Friendly staff, great ratings, breakfast buffet, beautiful rooms, pet friendly, shuttle to the Zoo. Thankful we we able to check-in early. The Valet was the best we have ever encountered & he really made the effort to make our stay great!

name: Princess Loving
text:
What a horrible place!! Don't waste your time or money!! The staff  are so unprofessional to be representing downtown Omaha.
Spend your money at another one of Omaha's downtown establishment seriously!

name: Liz Sherrill
text: Randall did a great job making sure everything went smoothly for my wedding block. Our suite was fantastic. The balcony view was amazing and the building itself is beautiful. The only thing guests reported as unsatisfactory was if they requested rooms next to each other (so they could be by their teenage kids) it wasn’t always honored, which caused some complications for them. Overall I would recommend this hotel!

name: CGH
text: I had no idea this hotel was even in Omaha. It is in the old federal building; built in the 20s. The rooms were modern, clean and comfortable. A great place to stay if you are downtown!

name: Elizabeth Dillon
text: Controlled entry, nice rooms, back patio with fire pit and seating, great service.

name: Jacob Geary
text: Good and classy

name: Daveoma
text: Everything and everybody was great except for Michelle at the front desk.  She wasn't mean exactly but as a paying customer I expect to be treated with friendliness.

name: nelmie72
text:
Staff was all very nice, prompt, and professional. The room was in perfect order, ready on time, with the extras in place, except for extra towels and pillows which were brought up soon after check-in without my having to ask for them. The separate bedroom was slightly chilly but not terrible. I really like that the bedspread is something easy to launder and easy to see that it's clean. I barely heard any noises from the hallway or neighboring rooms. The refrigerator even had an ice maker, and USB outlets were available in the kitchen counter area.
One of the best hotel experiences I've had in a long time.

name: keela mowles
text: Very clean, very nice. We walked into old market very quickly. The staff was very helpful, we forgot a phone charger and the front desk had one we could use. I made my booking online, and once we were there, Mickey, helped us get a room higher up. I also had trouble with the parking garage and they were very helpful. They do offer valet service for $15 a night, and they bring your car around and whatnot. 10/10 would stay again.

resp.text: Keela, thank you for the great review and rating!

name: Andy Callens
text: Admittedly, this was a blind deal on a popular trip website.  Rooms are considerably bigger then I'd expect in a historic property.  It was fun to nose around the building.  Try to get a Dodge street view if view matters to you. Not much to see on the south side.  Breakfast was adequate but nothing to write home about.

resp.text: Andy, thanks for the great comments and rating!

The rooms are roomy and very clean. Definitely recommend that if come to Omaha this is the place to experience a great stay. Just one thing it does not have pool.

text: Great place to stay downtown. Cool old bank building with original vault doors in the breakfast room. Shuttle will take you anywhere in a 3 mile radius.

name: Seeta Mangra-Stubbs
text:
We were at this hotel for two nights. The building is fascinating if nothing else.

Service was absolutely outstanding especially the valet.

The room was clean (if aging ever so sightly) and quite comfortable. I loved that the windows opened. We didn't have much of a view (just into the concrete of the parking garage), but having a widow that opened was amazing and helped us sleep.

It was pretty quiet in the halls. I deeply appreciated that. No one was loud enough to wake us. And I wanted to take the bed home with me.

Breakfast is what brought down the rating. The juice machine was out of order. The water carafe was empty, there was only coffee left, and I don't drink a lot of coffee. The waffle batter was empty as well.

We didn't realize they didn't have a pool, which is entirely our fault. But that kinda sucked. Still. Not their fault.

But my favorite part was that it was pouring rain and the fire pit out back in the courtyard was still on. I've seen fire, and I've seen rain.

resp.text: Seeta, thanks so much for the great review!

name: Dustin Thostenson
text: Great staff, location, and property.  Housekeeping hasn't let me down once.  Front desk, Valet and all other staff have been eager to please.  I feel very comfortable in this home-away-from-home.

resp.text: Dustin, thank you for the great review and rating! Happy to hear you emjoy our staff, location and property!

text: The location was nice, except that there wasn't parking at the hotel. There was a garage that was by the hour or meters on the street, however after nine was free on Friday. name: Wai Chan
text:
It is an amazing setting with a high end Alice in Wonderland vibe. It's dark, romantic, and the perfect setting for a drink.
I'd recommend the bar if you like to watch. The bartenders are talented.

You enter through a liquor store that is a front at the art deco Hotel building. No one seems to want to tell you what it is (even other guests waiting in line). Everyone suggests you go to Google and figure it out. We witnessed this like a strange conspiracy and decided to also not say anything unless we missed the memo.

There was a line when we got there, but the wait wasn't long. I've read the complaints on other reviews, where they said they did not know when they could get in. It's max capacity and they cannot control how long a patron will sit unless they are willing to kick someone out. Since they aren't (who wants to get asked to leave right?) They can't give a time estimate. That made sense.

The drinks can be magical. They specialize with 3 drinks that are on fire. They are artisans, so if the 3 do not appeal to you, you can make special requests and still receive the fire but in a different form.

The bar was dirty when I got there. My hair and my shirt (which ended up being stained) was wet from whatever leftover liquid was on the lip of the bar. When asked to have it cleaned, a bartender passed a rag so I could clean it myself.

My first drink was magical when I gave some direction. When I gave the bartender leave to make whatever they wanted, it was more plain and left me not wanting to order another. I'll admit my expectations are higher in a place like this.

I would defintely recommend checking this place out. Cocktail prices are set at $13, which is higher than most in the area, but in part, you are paying for the ambiance. They are craft cocktails made with fresh ingredients, and with bartenders that should tend to you more.
This place is what you make of it. Take advantage to talking to them as that is part of the price of admission.
Service was professional.

There was an attempt at this in my home city, but this was executed better. We had a few kinks, but if I return and they are one time issues, I would change my rating.

text: A speakeasy with the most mystical atmosphere I’ve ever experienced. You truly feel like Alice fallen down the rabbit hole and into the dark tunnel. Drinks are pricey but with it you get an amazing view of your bartender working her magic. Expertly crafted and delicious drinks await you. Highly recommend the Last Word and any of thier egg white cocktails. You can also enjoy some pretty delicious whiskey and bourbon with a large list of options. Not recommended for large groups as the space is very small. A gathering of three is doable but leave the birthday parties for a dive. No specific dress code but please leave the jeans and tees at home, you’ll feel out of place.

text: Came here on a Sunday evening because I had heard great things about this place. It's a Bar inside a liquor store. Super cool feeling walking in. It has been mentioned in previous reviews but the place is small. It sits about 10 people at the bar and 30 people around it. It is also very dimly lit which added to a relaxing and low key vibe which is exactly what I was looking for on a Sunday. The music playing wasn't too loud and was mainly EDM genre. The cocktails on the menu were all $13 so a little steep but a great place and taste! I ordered a gas chamber because I really wanted to try absinthe. A gas chamber is absinthe that is lit on fire and then poured over ice in a closed container so you can smoke the vapor that's released. Super cool watching the setup. I can honestly say I won't be being absinthe anytime soon because of the really strong taste but very cool nonetheless. Great place to bring friends from out of town to give them a unique experience. Once I save up more money I'll  be back!

name: Midwestern Julie
text: Not open to public. Awesome building. Walk in on the main floor & can look straight up to the roof of building. Center of building hollowed out. Pity no one but the people who works there gets to appriciate it all. Higher floors have great views of downtown.

name: Ian Richardson
text: Great place to work. Culture is welcoming and we have a very nice facility. Look forward to working here for many years.

name: Brad Kirshenbaum
text: They have a lunch area open to the public with very reasonably priced and delicious fare. Definitely worth going to as it has something for everyone.

name: nicci Bennett
text: Grandma credit union polite people

name: kent thorne
text: Recent layoff, bad retention, and falling wages. UP has lost the vision it once had to be a top employer in Omaha.

name: Sheryl Fredrick
text: It's a reasonable choice for lunch. Lots of choices, priced decent and fast.

name: Jacob Iverson
text: Coolest and most modern looking building downtown. Huge 19-story atrium with cafeteria is open to the public for breakfast and lunch.

name: Doug
text: Great food, a bit pricey. Have to pay for parking

name: Kozue T
text: I work here and I love the architecture of the building, it feels like it is making a statement.

name: Tim Schoell
text: We just went to the gift shop for my brother who loves trains.  All the other places were closed.

name: Karan Barnes
text: Never went inside just driving by

name: Outty 5000 hertz
text: It's my employer however the building is amazing!

name: Liam Lanigan
text: Nice building.

name: Aaron Wiese
text: Went for a work reason, but building seemed well maintained.

name: Ryan Kelley
text: Lots of great food options here

name: Dan D
text: Awesome building to visit!

name: Shane Beachler
text: Cool place to visit.

name: Greg S
text: I don't know much about this place but it looks like one of Omahas architecture marvel's from the outside.

name: Charlie Lee
text: Picking up insulin

name: Michael Barone
text: Beautiful Building

name: Israel Luna
text: Sweet

name: Miki Ram
text: At the train rail loading unloading ,specially a short fat guy ,aragonit ,racest .....service there sucks.

name: Dean Peterson
text: Great place to work.

name: John Idyakunnel
text: I work here

name: Jerry Meyers
text: Great place

name: Ray Brumley
text: Clean and friendly

name: Jeff McClenathan
text: Good food and reasonably priced

name: gio dan
text: Best RR in the world.

name: Josh Hansen
text: Fantastic Movie Experience!  Great food, excellent service and the kind of movie theater I want to be at.  Their strict no talking policy is outstanding.  My favorite place to go

name: Nicholas Kanning
text: Convenient location close to downtown Omaha with multiple screens and movies being played.  The Liquid Sunshine tavern is a great place to meet before and after the movie.  The theaters have reclined seating and the service team is committed to providing great service without interrupting your movie experience.  They even crouch when delivering and waiting as to not block the view of the screen.  This is my preferred theater in Omaha.

name: Charlie Dukes
text:
I love the Alamo, but the west location is my favorite of the 2 in Omaha (which is sad for me as I live in walking distance from this one). Food is good, cocktails are overpriced for their size and taste, but the beer makes the Sunshine Tap Room still one of my faves. They're always good for a delicious IPA on tap - my barometer for a good bar and grill.

I would recommend either Alamo for their movie parties, new releases, and any of their other showcases. Best theater in Omaha by far!

name: Ryne Donovan
text: Alamo at Midtown had alot to live up to and they succeeded! The renovations looks amazing and on top you have the standard that the Alamo sets. If you want a great place to get food, a great bar with a amazing selection of beer, and a movie theater without someone on their phones the Alamo is the place to be!

name: Jack Henry
text: Phenomenal theatre! If you are into license plates - don’t miss the walls! Great place to have a drink for happy hour even if you aren’t planning on watching movie.

name: Chris Mefford
text: Wonderful to have an Alamo location so close to downtown. While the screens are on the 4th floor, you have the option of stairs, escalator, or elevator. The theaters have powered recliners and still offer a great selection of drinks and food. The Liquid Sunshine Taproom has a marvelous view of Midtown and a very inviting and cozy feel.

name: Laffy Mctaffy
text: Great theater loved the building and the service. For everything we asked for on time and accurate. I think the building offers a really unique experience unlike anything in Omaha. They validate parking for three hours free in a nearby parking garage. Last the important part the Iron Giant was awesome!

name: Crystal Zimmerman
text: Tuesday's are $5 movie days. The seating is very comfortable, and the cost for food and drinks are comparable to eating at a typical restaurant. Instead of the $22 you spend at most theaters for popcorn and soda. The staff are always friendly, they great you when you sit down and continue to take orders throughout the movie. The

name: adam hoing
text:
Class Act Theater! The Alamo has movie going figured out! This company has transformed expectations from a very passive, attending a movie experience to a fantastic experience where you are waited on with food, drink and great customer service.

This location has plenty of parking within a reasonable walking distance.

The service is great. I don't find the waiters or waitresses to be distracting at all. We brought 3 children to see Lion King and the staff was very accommodating! We will be returning to this theater soon!

name: Barbara Favara
text: It's clean, the seating is comfortable, the food although pricey is pretty good and there are little tables in front of you to put it on.  Each theater is not too large and the screen is a good size with good quality sound.  There's also a bar and restaurant before you go into the theater.   It's a nice place.

name: Michael Puskar
text: A unique experience. The seating is comfortable and the atmosphere is solid. They provide in-seating service, which is nice. The popcorn is excellent. The candy comes in cool containers and you get more than a normal box. All in all a great experience.

name: Joshua Monroe
text: This is only the second Alamo draft house I've been to, but it maintains the consistent cool feel that I'm familiar with. I really like the layout of this location, with the box office/ shop on the first floor, the bar on the second floor, and the theaters on the third floor. The staff in both the bar and the theater were very friendly. The seats were comfortable. I just wish I still lived across the street so I could visit more often.

name: Andrea Barahona
text:
Love the concept of table service at the movies!

Price wise, a tad pricey, but it's an enjoyable experience. I also like the decor, the food was good, and the seat was comfy. My only complaint is you can't entirely lie down on these recliners. But it's still very comfortable.

name: Jacob Safranek
text: Love Alamo!! It has great seating and amazing food! Staff is kind as well. A little bit on the pricy side, but that’s a given since it’s a movie theatre.

name: Siobhan Angelisa
text: Great spot for dinner & a movie. There's a great selection of food & drinks. I always try something new but their Sriracha wings and loaded fries are my favorite

name: Andrew Schmitt
text: Movie was good, seats were comfy, food good but I ordered a dirty martini that came with sweet vermouth. It was brownish red and sweet, so I brought it to the bar and waited 15 minutes before a single person asked me if I needed anything. Didnt want to be late to the move so as a walked away (I think the manager noticed I was upset) a manager asked if she could help, I told here my problem, she asked what seat. I told her, and 15 min later a drink showed up. It was not good, but at least this time there was no sweet vermouth. Dont order drinks here (unless it's a beer).

name: Leah Beda
text: Love this location!  The seats have a slight recline which is much better than the Alamo in La Vista.  The service is always good and I like how they validate your tickets so parking is never a problem.

name: Thomas Boyko
text: SOOOOO much better than the location in exit 442! Better seats, better crowd, and the decor is amazing!

name: Kevin Laurenti
text: I simply won't watch movies at any theater that's not Alamo. They've set the bar too high, not only with customer service, but the quality of the experience. I love all the special events and movies, and how they show fun videos before a movie instead of commercials. This in and of itself is a huge improvement over other theaters. Food is also great, albeit a little pricey, but has never felt not worth it.

name: Hugh Lasauskas
text: Comfortable chairs, well timed service, BOTTOMLESS POPCORN  for 7 bucks! Less than most places for one pop corn. Spacious seating and I love love love the no talking or texting rule. And yes they will kick you out. Overall great experience.

name: D K
text: Done very well since it's grand opening. A unique movie going experience abound with retro cinematic references and complete with a bar and in-theater service! Not the most kid friendly though, and there's a lot of open space just begging for additions.

name: Tamra Hawks
text: I love both locations. Alamo is the only place we go to see movies. The midtown location lives up to the standards with yummy food and delicious drinks. The seats are comfortable and the staff is friendly and quick!

name: Michelle Watts-Avila
text: Comfy reclining seats, and clean. Excellent dining service and good food. It's the best way to watch a movie. My favorite theater.

name: Dylan Dingbaum
text: The Alamo Drafthouse did it again. I was not disappointed when I went to go see a movie before the actual movie theater opened (soft opening) and they were training their employees. It's three stories and it has an amazing atmosphere. Amazing service, great food, and drinks. I will definitely be returning to this location 10 out of 10 Stars 10/10

name: Airbrush Mike Art Garage
text: Love it go as much as we can!!!! Great food and beer while you watch your movie.  I think great!!!! We ended up going downtown , didn't realize they had 2 in omaha! Good experience free covered parking garage, nice big facility, friendly staff and the movie price was very reasonable. I think we paid $12 for 2 tickets!!! Really fun place to go see a movie and eat out with your special someone!!!!

name: Sean RN
text: Quality, clean location. Alamo has an amazing system of making you feel like you are in the best seat in the theater, no matter where you are. The food is good, the service is prompt, and the theater is comfortable and clean.

name: Diane Terry
text: We had an family emergency and had to leave a few minutes after the movie started. The staff gave us complimentary passes to come back and threw in a credit toward food and drinks. They took care of us! The only thing I don't like about this place is that the seats don't recline all the way back, it's more like a 3/4 recline. Not bad, it'd be better for it to go back further.

name: Shawn Hough
text:
We 💕 Alamo Midtown.  There's free covered parking, all seats are recliner type, & you can get real food instead of just popcorn & pop. There is a no talking & cellphone use rule. Love that.
You take the escalators up to 3rd floor.
They do have elevators.
Don't forget to have your parking validated. I recommend the soft pretzel, chicken nuggets, & they even have breakfast like French toast.

name: Nita Mora
text: I like how they have a "no late entry" rule because it ensures no one's movie experience is ruined. Their recliners are really comfortable and their five dollar Tuesday deal is always nice. Overall, a great movie experience.

name: Miranda Rocha
text: First time at the Alamo. We had a wonderful experience. The staff was friendly and helpful and love the environment! The food being yummy was just the cherry on top!

name: animoD
text: Nice place with good food. The seats are subpar compared to the ones Marcus theaters uses. The paper card ordering system needs some kind of alert button, because on busy nights in the front row waitstaff may not see it or have time to check.

name: Trese Rousseau
text: Great experience. Friendly staff. The service could be better.. meaning customers shouldn't have to ask servers for drinking straws & wait throughout the entire movie - for the server to not bring them. At all. After requesting them 10 minutes after you've received drinks (before the movie even started). Other than that, very much improved from the previous theater. The atmosphere & decor offers a much more casual "hometown bar" feel. The leather seats & dining setup are a tremendous improvement!! Very comfortable. Drinks were good, reasonably priced. Idk what the food is like though.

name: Marco Juarez
text: The service has started to get worse, especially since opening. It takes forever to get your first order and by the time you do, you dont want to order anymore. Kinda sucks because we would definitely buy more if we could.

name: Laura Betz
text: This place is amazing. They have a great view of midtown and put on really great events like the clue movie night. I'm so glad that they moved into this space. I loved the buffalo cauliflower and their rotating drink specials that match whatever movie you are there to see.

name: Josh Moeller
text: Great theater, great food, great location, great atmosphere.

name: Johanna Schubert
text:
Drinks: Didn’t have 2 of the beers on the menu. Took them over an hour to check our ticket for a refill. Water never came or offered.
Service - delivered our drink to the empty table next to us baffled where it should go. Then repeated the same maneuver with our food, and almost walked it back.
Alamo Drafthouse in LaVista is a far superior experience every time!

name: Fatima A
text: Great spot for date night and to watch movies! I love the atmosphere and unique dining experience. They have movie parties and special screenings!

name: Charlie Brown
text: I love the movie dining experience and Alamo does a terrific job at it.  the staff is always friendly the theater seats are comfortable and spacious, and the food is really good.

name: C T
text: Awesome atmosphere, delicious food and cocktails, went to see one of their movie parties and had a blast. I recommend an adult milkshake  and the buffalo cauliflower, it's almost as good as the fried green beans they used to have.

name: Tony Hartzell
text: Great concept. Mediocre prices. And even though the servers are infinitely less disruptive than their pre-Alamo Midtown Crossing theatre counterparts, it's still annoying af. There has to be a better way.

name: J
text: Fantastic 1st time experience! The bartender on 2 separate trips with my Dad was fantastic, and helpful hell even the cashier at the ticket counter and an employee that took time to ask how much enjoyed everything simply because he was walking beside us!

name: Aaron Wiese
text: I really appreciate having access to this type of theater near my home. The amenities manifold, the seats comfortable, and the experience of seeing a movie without having to worry about distractions from other patrons is a huge draw for me. I'll generally chose this theater over any other.

name: David Batson
text:
As has been my experience with every Alamo I've been to, fine and quiet service lightly punctuated an overall excellent movie going outing. This location is clean and well maintained and the chairs are comfortable.

The food was very tasty, albeit overpriced, and all of the staff was courteous and friendly. I fully recommend this location, as close to a fine shopping and eating area as it is.

Just don't forget to have them validate your parking.

name: David Roach
text: never been to a theater like this before I'll definitely give another theater like this a try I will definitely be back to this one if I'm through the area thank you it was awesome

name: RL Pelshaw
text: Avoid the crowds  and  go there. I do hope this place makes it.  This was my first time at Midtown as I usually go to La Vista. I was shocked that we had the theater to ourselves, on a weekend night for a very popular movie. The place was nicely redone. Needless to say we had great service! Concession prices are way cheaper at Alamo with the same or better quality. And who doesn't love all you can eat popcorn for $7 - brought to your seat so you don't have to get up and miss part of the movie

name: SHAWTY SO BOSSY™
text: Like the new update to this movie theater. The seats are comfortable. Would like to see better dessert options on the menu besides just cookies and one other option.

name: Chessly Lynn Loper
text: I thought the Lavista Alamo was the best until I went to midtown. New recliners, and bigger screens are at the new location. You will still get amazing food, and service at both locations. The adult shakes and bottomless popcorn are a few of my favorites. :)

name: Erin Cooper
text: The new Midtown Alamo has all the makings of another great theater. While it was apparent during my visit that the staff are still learning the ropes - I would never fault them for that as they've just opened and a learning curve is to be expected. The food and service were nevertheless wonderful, and I can't wait to visit again.

name: Summer Hall
text: The food was good, but there wasn't a lot of choices, the prices are what you'd expect - a little up there. As a theater, it was good, the chairs reclined a little, unlimited popcorn for 7$, nice place. As a restaurant, it was weird. The tray tables are way to small and they don't move, so it's kinda useless, and you'll probably have to share it with a stranger which kinda sucks. The whole idea is badly executed, the servers have to awkwardly crawl at your feet and whisper questions to you, and honestly it's just super creepy. And it's hard to order something in the dark, after the movies started (ya, those little lights don't help like at all). Although I'm making it sound kinda horrible, we had a lot of fun!! We probably will go back, and it was just a neat experience overall.

name: lottorabbit
text: Went to see a movie Saturday evening.  Comfortable seats. Their "system" for ordering needs work.  It took forever to place the order.  Then after the order for "bottomless" popcorn and Coke finally arrived, the movie was half over.  I tried to get a refill on both and nobody came by to check the "paper" that I turned up to signal I wanted a refill.   There's no light to turn on to signal that you want something.  So much for " bottomless" popcorn and drink refills.  I live across the street and would rather drive to another theatre.

name: Felicia 1122
text: Like the reclining seats, not broken down. Love the order menus at a reasonable price and free 3 hr parking in garage. Will be going back.

name: Guy Lewis
text: Its dope. The trippy trailers are really interesting

name: steven smith
text: The overall everything was nice except for the seating  not made bigger ppl

name: Derek Ruppert
text: First time to this location.  Normally go to the Lavista location.    The interior looks great and has the smell and feel of the other Alamo.  Had to deduct for the service and food.   We normally come super early, but couldn't this time.  We were still there  before the trailers started.  Wasn't the same greeting and welcome we were used to.  Asked for two waters and a BLT w a side of ranch .  One drink came.  Waited about 5 minutes to put up a sign just asking about the other drink to a different person.  Waited about 10 more before I asked again and received the water.  The  food came later.  Fries were stone cold and no side of ranch.  I will still be back as I love these theaters.

name: Jay Ireland
text: Great theater experience but don't expect to get a water unless you buy something

name: Joseph Bolil
text: Good  sight lines and menu choices, could be less costly than traditional dinner and a movie. Just make sure you arrive the 20-30 minutes before to take best advantage of ordering

name: Kayla J
text: We did walk in and still able to find good seats an the food was great. The seats are not the greatest on accessibility so be prepared to squeeze and maneuver choose a end cap seat for best fit.

name: Randall Smith
text: A great theater experience. Staff are friendly and service is prompt, food is creative and tasty, great drink selections and of course picture and sound system are fantastic.

name: Tim Snyder
text: Love the Alamo in general, but the service needs servere work, 3x now that people that sit down well after us get waited on before us and they never see order cards it seems. Seats are a tad snug but that's my fault too :-)

name: Sara Born
text:
First time at this movie theater,  really nice. Great seats, full! service throughout the movie.
Will definitely return !

name: JS Myzyx
text: Can not say enough wonderful praise for this establishment. Everything about their service and culture is like a dream! 🎥 ❤ 💕

name: Kynie Weak
text:
Customer Service is rad.

Movie parties are so much fun.

Compared to other theaters like AMC this place is cheap, fun, and the food is okay.

10/10 will watch movies again.

name: Alexander Pope
text: While I really want to give this a four or five star I can’t. We have been 4 times since it opened as we live nearby. They are short staffed to the point the food is taking 40 minutes to come out. Also when you put up a paper to order something they may or may not see it for 20 minutes. The last time we went they forgot to give the entire room their bill until after the movie was over and we had to wait 30 minutes to run all of our cards. It just opened so I am hoping it improves but it’s surprising to be a month into their opening and it still me so questionable .

name: Chad Beal
text: This a a model of how an Alamo theater should be. The seats are nicely cushioned recliners unlike the other Alamo in town. I think slightly larger tables would make it perfect. The only reason this isn't a 5 star is they serve their moscow mule in a glass instead of a copper mug (it's not a Moscow mule if it's in anything but copper. A friendly staff always seemed to be on hand. All in all this theater doesn't disappoint.

name: Aj Cole
text: Amazing atmosphere. Friendly energetic staff.  Only issue was a mixed drink I ordered in the theater was too strong. Oddly enough.

name: Nate Betz
text: I agree with the criticism of the popcorn but I love the overall experience that you get otherwise. They have some in house made preshowing videos that are good to get you caught up a movie if in a series of movies. They also do older movie showings that I'd like to see.

name: Adam Vogel
text: I enjoy the Alamo. They do a good job with good food and a nice environment. Just wish the seats reclined more.

name: Martin Koehler
text:
Kinda miss Marcus in Midtown. Had better seating. Food is better than other locations, service was great.

Overall a positive experience.

name: Laura Steffes
text: This is a great addition to the Midtown establishments.  We just had so far d'oeuvres and the chicken meatballs in marinara sauce what was very tasty. Perfect amount for just wanting munchie that have with a beer.  And speaking of beers; they have a good selection of all the local beers on tap.  And Joel our waiter was very personable and knowledgeable on all the food items and beers.  Didn't go to a movie but looking forward to coming again and checking that part out as well.

name: Tracy Coleman
text: The movie was funny and cute but saw most of it in the previews.  Had a newbie couple a few seats down from me that thought they knew how to whisper!  I almost reported them.  I let it slide.  I come to this theater because of the 'No Talking and No cell phones' policy.

name: Devin
text: Good food for a good price at a movie theater and its delivered right to your seat

name: Caleb Green
text: Place is cool, full service for food movies and drinks, can be a little pricey but still good for a night out

name: Susan Murphy
text: Good service. Not too cold in the theater. Our movie experience was very nice

name: latasha bolden
text: The seats are definitely not made for a person of size.  However the staff was very accommodating.

name: Jeremy Mitchell
text: A fantastic renovation over the Marcus that.was here. Good food, good service and a great rotation of movies current, cult, and otherwise. I'm stoked to not have to go to Gretna to have a top notch movie going experience in Omaha!

name: Lee Ervin
text: Very clean, very nice employees. Everyone seems eager to help. I love that it is so uniquely designed and it is multiple stories.

name: Sabrina Glozeris
text: I used to like this theater. Tonight the service was terrible. We were there 30 minutes early, which is recommended so you can order food, but the theater wasn't ready yet. Once it was it still wasn't in good order as there were popcorn pieces left on the table. It took several minutes before a server came by for our order. Half hour later we got one meal, but not the other, and no drinks. Sec meal arrived, but drinks took another several more minutes. Then they kept trying to bring food and drinks that we didn't order. It was like they didn't know what order went where. The call buttons didn't work so we couldn't request drink refills, and our server didn't come back until it was time to drop off the check.

name: Frankie MacGregor
text: It doesn't quite have the same swank and pizzazz as the West location. It appears the staff is the same as when it was Marcus and there's just a touch of professionalism missing. Also, it's a smaller theater so it doesn't have as much selection. I often check their listings hoping to go see something good and am usually disappointed.

name: Raya Bby
text: Nice places to catch a movie and enjoy a well cooked dinner at the same time. There is nice seating with tables to enjoy your meal in a dim light area. Movie specials depending on the day of the week.

name: JEFF PETERS
text:
It is a fun cinema in the urban zone of Midtown. All the style of a big city style movie theater in the friendly Midwest. This is a multi-level complex attached to Midtown Crossing. Inside is the theaters, and several lounge areas. Player grand piano in the lobby. They also have in seat cinema dining. Something they call Cine-dine. You order bar/pub type foods and they are delivered to your seat. You can eat while watching the show. You can also get drinks of the youth and adult varieties.

Proves for the movies are standard if not a little cheaper than a lot of the cinema houses in town. The have matinee prices before noon as well as youth and senior pricing. The foods are reasonable, about what you would pay in a pub or casual sit down restaurant.  I did not find this intrusive during the show I went to today. As a matter of fact, I did not even see them bring my credit card back, all of a sudden it was there, so the really try not to disturb the movie going experience.

All in all a fun place for a show, meal and drinks.

name: B W
text: Awesome environment and staff! Always have a good time there.

name: Nick TV
text: Big fan of their food menu and service. Liquid Sunshine Taproom is a great place to stay before/after a movie or just a place to grab dinner and drinks

name: Matthew David
text: Good to have this theater opening up and running. Food was excellent started with a couple appetizers and we're so satisfied didn't even need popcorn.plus they have some neat t-shirts and swag that you can purchase down in the lobby.great to have a theater back in midtown, welcome to the neighborhood!

name: George Broadway
text: Wonderful theater. Very comfortable reclining seats and table service for food and beverages.

name: Haylee Huskey
text: Very nicely redone. Friendly staff. The only thing I didn't like was the seats. They were comfortable but the leg rests didn't go all the way up which was a little annoying. And they have $5 tickets on Tuesdays!!!!

name: iowamamaof3 Renee
text: Alamo Drafthouse is the place to go for movies! Esp. the movie parties! check out their website for all the fun movie parties. The food is delish! Try the queso & chips and fried pickles. VERY clean & well kept. Friendly staff!

name: Omar Martinez
text: Alamo Drafthouse has been the upgrade the midtown cinema needed for a long time. The food before Alamo took over was very bland and the seats were horrible. Alamo Drafthouse had came in to save us from that and not to mention the place looks amazing. The food is outstanding and the customer service is some of the best I have ever experienced. I am definately a regular here now.

name: Ashley Chasek
text: The work they did to refresh the old Marcus theater was well worth it! The interior looks great, the food and service is spot-on and I love that they kept the reclining Marcus-style seats. The seating is my one and only complaint about the La Vista location.

name: Kevin Henry
text: Love the drinks. Staff is friendly and parking is convenient.

name: Tom Fritz
text: Great theater. Super friendly staff.

name: Jared Cook
text: Pro tip. Show up early and eat and drink in the bar area. Easier than eating in the dark theater.

name: Zach Widger
text: Lovely theater with great seats and even better food.

name: Jack5onT
text: Really high quality theater with great audio, screens, and chairs. I haven't tried ordering a meal here, but it's kind of nice to have the option.

name: Sherry Cronin
text: It was so cool to watch a movie and order food and drinks from your seat.

name: Lyndsey Johnson
text: Food and movie. Movies cheap.  Food not so cheap, but good. Overall experience very good.  Nice theaters,  some have recliner chairs and 1 row of seats at a table like setting, better for food. Clean.  Nice staff.

name: Chad Sideris
text:
I have never been to a dinner theater, so maybe I am missing the point a bit. I ended up in a theater where only the front seats were actual seats and the others were all nice swivel chairs. The problem is there is a counter-top in front of your face. Unless you sit straight up or in the front three rows, you are destined to a night of relative discomfort, because you can't lean at all.

The theater is nice, the staff was nice, but I would prefer a regular seat.

name: Brett Edwards
text: Excellent movie experience.  Service does vary with the server but usually it is pretty good.  Have been here more than a dozen times and is the only place to see a movie.  Prices are very reasonable and the menu changes are fun.  Best place to take kids as refills are taken care of by the servers.  The pizzas and pretzels are great.  Keep up the great work!

name: Nathan Dunning
text: Nice theater in Midtown. Has a good sized bar on one of the floors.

name: iola sutton
text: I was nice and my grown kids liked it too

name: William Swett
text:
Ok, let me say that I LOVE going to the movies. To WATCH the movies.

I know they serve food, and that's their schtick... but it is really annoying having a server at your table/chair... or the ones to either side of you... doing the loud-whisper thing to get an order... deliver food... settle the check, etc.

And that's all without the distraction of people chomping away - loudly - on whatever they ordered.

I didn't order anything, so I can't comment on the food - but it seemed terribly overpriced, and the table thing you eat it off seemed awkwardly far from the chair, like a TV-dinner tray placed just out of reach (yah, dated reference, now get off my lawn).

The image and audio quality was superb, however, and they host a lot of awesome cult and genre movies with great twists, so I REALLY WANT to like this place...

Maybe the second time will be the charm.

name: Dessa Caldwell
text: Great drinks and quality food in a very comfortable theater environment

name: Wesley Hall
text:
The staff is always friendly(not the youngest manager). The food is always good. It's a nice place to take a date(it was). Something unusual yet not strange(okay it's getting strange).

Update; Every time we go they mess something up. Usually they more than fix it. This time they started the movie early, apparently they can't stop it once started. That's what they told us anyway. So we missed the first 10 minutes of Blade runner 2049. After several pointed questions about why it started early, and stating l felt cheated. A manager finally offered a were sorry paper. I had to drag it out what good is that, he said a free movie.

Later after l came out of the restroom, which has the same 2 broken urinals for months now. I saw the manager running to hide from a couple yelling at him probably the same issue.

Oh yes and my son ordered one thing and got another, they brought him the wrong drink again. Really the mistakes are getting old.

name: Jenifer w
text:
It is awkward to get in/out of recliners with the stationary table blocking them.
Staff is awesome, food is okay, drinks are inconsistent.
Still working out some kinks from recently opening this site, totally understandable.

name: Cora Hollingsworth
text: I liked the Alamo, but the lights to see the menu isn't very bright so it's kind of hard to see, and the waiters leave so quickly it's hard to make requests and ask questions.

name: Brenda Dolinski
text: Food was great just didn't get our popcorn BUT the popcorn made up for it!

name: Michelle Davis
text: Parking is horrible. Validation still meant I had to pay 4 bucks.  Go to lavista.  It is still that alamo so it is still better than other theaters.

name: Sarah Christensen
text: After going to the location in La Vista, I was a bit disappointed in this location. It's a big upgrade from when it was the Marcus theater but the seating wasn't impressive as it was at the other location and we had to leave the movie to find a server after the movie started. There was no call button!! I still love Alamo over other chains so I didn't knock off more than one star.

name: Don M
text: Excellent theater! However the seats are starting to get a little worn so they probably should consider replacing or fixing to keep up with the great amenities. The food is also excellent, but the pizza is consistently made differently even when you order the same pizza day after day. They are made with too much tomato sauce, or next day it doesn't have enough or the ingredients are thrown all over the place and not spread evenly. Occasionally the chef does it right and it is an excellent pizza.

name: Mindy Peterson
text: They validate parking, everyone was so nice, the theater was awesome! I will go back!

name: Curtis & Lynn Prather
text: This Alamo has the best of both worlds, reclining seats and the bring you food. The menu has it's constants but has seasonal items as well.

name: Jessica Plants
text: I love this littler theatre, except there is a limited amount of movies kept here because its a little smaller. They offer the full menu and themed cocktails. Overall very clean and tidy. Staff is always helpful.

name: Lyndsey Johnson
text: Nice theatre. Nice area. (downtown@ Midtown Crossing). You can order real meals(dinner) & eat while watching movie in theatre. Good food. Tickets are decent price. Some seats are like comfy computer chairs at a desk like table, others are "traditional" movie theatre seats. Overall good experience.

name: Robin Menck
text: I love this theater and it's even better since Alamo took over.

name: Kisha Wilson
text: I love the atmosphere, seats, and the food is delicious.

name: Joshua Hanner
text: Perfectly happy to grandstand themselves into bankruptcy, I guess. Enough is enough. You can reopen now.

name: Greg Seery
text:
We went there for a soft-opening movie where the all-new staff was still in training, service was a bit spotty but I expect that once they have a little experience that should change.
The seats are recliners and fairly comfortable, although the armrest between paired seats doesn't raise out of the way. Theaters have a smallish footprint, which means that the rise between each row of seats is higher than usual. I didn't know that when I reserved our seats about 6 rows up, and the climb could be difficult for anyone with impaired physical abilities. An elevator is available that gets to higher levels of seats, but it wasn't immediately obvious.
One design flaw that was noticable. They have movie posters in glass cases along the wall where the theater doors are situated, many of these are right across from floor to ceiling windows overlooking Farnum Street and the glare on those cases makes it difficult to see the posters.

name: Alan Gochenour
text: Extremely courteous staff, reclining seats are nice, location and parking are perfect.

name: Amber Sturdivant
text: The food is great & their shake "The King" is definitely my guilty pleasure.

name: Bentleyspop
text: Great movie programming,  awesome beer selection, but only 4 stars due to wrong beer delivered during movie.

name: XieXie ThankYou

name: Brett Scollard

name: Marlin Palasek
text: Good movie, good food, cool location and decor.  Service a bit slow, but they did recognize that and gave us a break on the food bill.

name: Rodney Hay
text: Nice place to watch a movie. They serve beer and food in the movie as well.

name: Precious Smith
text: love this theater. love their service as well.

name: Brenda Norton
text:
Worst movie experience ever. Didn't realize we'd be sitting in office chairs at a desk. (My bad.) My chair was broken and kept sinking down I had to adjust it about every 10-15 minutes so I could see over the "desk".

We were the first ones in the room and our food still took forever. Then both orders came out wrong and took even longer to fix. When i finally got right food, and silverware to use, the chicken was so freezer - burned I couldn't even finish it.   Never got a drink refill. Then when they brought our check, it was wrong too. Then that took forever to fix.

I will never go back.

name: Joe Nicholson
text:
12-26-17

My wife and I had a terrible experience at this theater.  We were told that they weren't serving any food because their truck didn't come in.  That tells me they have questionable management.

We stuck around for cold popcorn and flat beer while we sat in broken office chairs.  The theater temperature was maybe 60*.  We both watched with our coats and gloves on.

Our server didn't seem to be excited to be working.

We eventually left after 30 minutes or so because neither of us were comfortable.

There are many other theaters in Omaha so I highly doubt either of us will ever be back.  I was really hoping this wouldn't happen since this location is close to downtown and would be perfect for date nights after work on our way home.

name: Elizabeth Miller
text: Great theater. In a convenient place, shows all the new movies. They have a lounge, a bar, and the theater is 3 levels high! While watching the movie, you have a table in front of you and you can order drinks, appetizers, desserts, or whole meals!!! I love it, amazing movie experience

name: David Bradley

We ordered food before the movie (after flagging someone down) and never got it, which was frustrating because we had to sit through the movie hungry as we had planned on having lunch there. We talked to the waitress afterwards to make sure our card didn't get charged... She actually didn't answer our question and simply told us we were "good to go"...cool, thanks.

name: Dan Jenkins
text: I'm really disappointed with the service and quality of food here. I've gone about 5 or 6 times and the last few have been pretty bad experiences. I went to watch the latest star wars movie on a Monday night. The movie started at 630pm so we arrived at 610. It wasn't even half full since it was a Monday. We ordered two pops and a medium popcorn. The pop arrived, with no ice, at 7pm and the popcorn arrived at 715pm and it was cold. We watched prepared food be delivered to people that ordered after us. This isn't the first time this has happened here. They seem to have problems getting food out in a timely manner. I don't think I'm being irrational when expecting my popcorn and drinks to arrive in 10 or 15 minutes. In the past I've ordered cheese sticks and it took over an hour to get my food. I've ordered a burger and got it 20 minutes left in the movie. So like I said, the time to get drinks and food has been an issue for several trips.

text:
While the decor is nicely appointed, inside the theater the tables are really close to the individual recliner seats making anyone with wife hips either going to be in recline mode for the whole movie or have to shift to ensure the seat does not go back.

The bar is nice and we'll put together.  Unlike the lavista one, the movie posters are in a dim hall way and not illuminated. Nor are they computer screens with a backlight.

The new iron giant statue is nice but I feel they could do more to improve upon that space. Maybe move tye merch section into the old ticket booth area , set up areas to have it more open than a corner as you enter the door on the ground level.

The speaker systems are clearly new and provided a surprising amount of thump to them for action sequence. .

Overall this is a good option and it's nice to see a second Alamo Drafthouse in the area.

text: Very comfortable seats and it's nice that you can order food and drinks for during the movie, this is my favorite theater.  That said they need a lot of work. One of them told us 20 minutes before we got them that they were on the way, and he would have brought them himself, but he wasn't old enough.  This situation isn't a one time thing either.  The food or the drink is always late.  Still worth going just don't expect you stuff on time, and order early.  - okay so just went back again first time didnt have a ton of problems, the food was way better and got everything at a reasonable time...i think it may just be because it was the first time we went to a showing at 5pm, usually we do the later movies.

Theater seating (glorified office chairs at a long desk) were broken and didn't roll.  Several customers around me had the same problem.  For this type of movie & dinning experience go west to the Alamo in LaVista.  Spent about the same money for better seating and better staff - especially if your with a date.

When we received the check nothing had been altered.  Very disappointed.

text: Good movie selection, good sound, and great to have a meal brought to me. Not so big on the cracker-crust pizzas, love the rotation of mixed drinks.

name: Larry Britton
text:
I love the VIP seating in Theatre 1, very comfortable reclining seats.  Sound is excellent, and the screen is a good size for the theater.  The drinks are generous in size and are mixed well. they have a good selection of beers, including Guinness Stout and Stella Artois, as well as domestics.  Saw Star Trek there last week and it was a great movie experience. I see many organizations have company parties there and that would be a fun time.
Our server Izzi was quick, courteous and accurate with our order.  Ask for her on Friday and Saturday nights.  These servers work hard in difficult surroundings, so tip well if they deserve it!

name: Matt P
text: One of my favorite theaters because it is in a convenient location. Free parking in the parking garage is a plus. $5 movies on Tuesdays is also a bonus. Only gave it 4 stars due to no late night movie offerings.

name: George Galooli
text: There was a deal going on with some cereal company where you could get a free movie ticket if you saved a certain number of codes and sent them in. I saved mine for months and sent for my free ticket. I received their free ticket coupon and tried to use it when I was out on a date. The attendant said s/he had never seen it before and refused to honor it even though I knew this theater was on this list of participating theaters. The cashier didn't bother to ask anyone, so my date, probably embarrassed, just went ahead and paid for my ticket. I emailed this theater later on and explained my situation. The man said he's send me a free voucher (or gift card, can't recall)  if I gave him my address, so I did. I never received anything from them in the mail. I emailed him again saying I never got it and he didn't respond. I went from embarrassed to just mad.

text:
Short answer don't waste your time. Service this bad goes to management credit. They must not train at all.
Nice theater with a brilliant concept : bellhops and a full menu. Fun. Ok so when I get there ticketbooth can't change my bill and doesn't offer someone else to make change forcing me use my card. Ok that's fine whatever. Then I ask for candy and she tells me I purchase that at my theater and they can make change there. (The people she should have had sent up in first place maybe) Did I mention she wasnt friendly? Ok so I get to theater and the bellhop was outside and I said i want candy for my daughter what do you have. He didn't know! Well do you have pictures or what? He went in and grabbed the actual candy to show us. And his helper told me he wasnt supposed to do this for me. For me? Im trying to buy some. We get candy and I tell the guy they should get pictures and attach them to the menu board so we can see like the pictures of burgers and drinks. He don't care plus tells me were not even supposed to order in the hallway but actually at our seats. Well excuse me. Ok so maybe I had this place all wrong its a restaurant that you watch movies at. I get inside and order a drink. We already have the candy so 1 drink is all he needs to grab. Took 10 minutes. Then he comes back and I ask about getting my daughter a drink he said kids drink free but I could have heard that when I ordered mine. Then I noticed he short changed me. I was livid. All this hassle and there police is not to deal with coin change? Then why not round up to whole dollars like EVERYONE ELSE! Plus there toilet was broken and soap was empty. I can't make this stuff up.

name: Dave Reid
text:
Go somewhere else for dining and movies - each experience has gotten worse.

My wife, our friend and I attended a 7:15 PM movie, Saturday night on Memorial Day weekend, so they were a little busy, but not packed at all. We go to Midtown Cinema to be able to dine with the movie (CineDine), and each visit to the theatre has been more and more disappointing related to CineDine. By far tonight's was the worst and we will likely not be back again.

Placed our order with our waiter about 7 PM for three meals, an appetizer, two waters, a bottle of beer, and a pop (nothing complex). Two of the three meals arrived about 7:20 - fairly reasonable, except it wasn't until half an hour later when our third meal and appetizer arrived along with silverware and napkins. Even then we still had none of our drinks. After asking another passing employee on their way back It wasn't until about 8 PM when all of the drinks except my pop have arrived. Yet another reminder is made to the employee that dropped off those drinks.

Finally over an *hour* after ordering and three reminders, the last drink, my pop arrives. Which of course means most of our meals are also cold by the time our respective drinks have arrived. The reason we were told that it took an hour to deliver one pop is that they were "very busy" despite seeing multiple people in our same theatre getting drinks and even refills delivered.

We only successfully got refills on our water/soda once the entire time, despite multiple polite requests. We were half-heartedly told with an hour left in the movie that our server would "try to get that [refill] to you."

Other things that have been bad:
- Condiments are never checked if they're almost empty at each food "station". Every *single* time we've been there the ketchup bottles (and the ones around us) are always near empty if not already out.
- Pulled pork sandwich was very bad this time despite previous good quality - meat was dry, tough and inedible.
- Orders never completely correct (try to ask for a side of anything with your meal - just dare you)
- Preview audio levels are always way louder than the actual movie. These are not supposed to be TV commercials.

If you want a dinner and movie experience, there's a good reason that these two are usually separate. If you want a decent dining experience, go to a real restaurant where you will have only one server that can provide better attention and service rather than the multiple employee hand-offs (at least five different people this visit) that you get at CineDine. If you want a decent movie theatre experience in mid-town Omaha, I'd much rather recommend Aksarben Cinema in Aksarben Village. The staff there seems to actually care. Until then, only go here if you are not using CineDine.

text: We have been here a few times and it's a really fun place for the kids:) everyone that goes in has to pay for either a buffet or a play pass to go in, even if your child is the only one playing games one of these has to be paid for you to go in. Ordering your passes online is cheaper but if your just doing a buffet pass it is cheaper to buy it at the actual place. There are 4 dinning rooms to eat in and multiple rooms to do birthday parties in. A huge salad bar, a section of their specials of the day, the pizza section which includes up to 7 different kinds of pizza, the baked potato bar and nacho bar. 2 ice cream machines and a dessert bar. They also serve alcohol drinks too. The kids liked the food but my husband and I didn't like it. Remember this a kids place, so this is not fine dinning. The food offered on the afternoon, for lunch is different then the evening which was nice. Every night at 5 they have a special that they set out for the evening. My husband and I stuck to the fried food just because we didn't like the pizzas or pasta and the sauces and dressing were watered down. They did have 3 pop machines, a tea fountain drink, and a slush machine, coffee and cappuccino machine with coffee too. The games. They have laser tag, bumper cars, bowling, go carts, a frog hopper ride and spinning car ride, along with tons of games. Points to play games are put into a card as well as the tickets you earn from playing those games. A lot of the games just take your points and give you few tickets so we played slot of the games that said right on them, x amount if tickets if you win or lose. That was just how we did things. We also went at 1230 and stayed until 5 just so we could do lunch and dinner there since it is so expensive. The kids had a ton of fun and that's what we went there for!
