The first is the arcade, bowling, laser tag, virtual reality, go carts, bumper cars, etc... This side of The Amazing Pizza Machine is great. Our children, ages 5-8 love every minute of The fun. The prices are reasonable and the kids have lots of options.

The other side, the side that is underwhelming, is the buffet. This business has made the purchase of a buffet meal mandatory. This is the part that is mildly frustrating. The buffet is what you would expect. Low quality foods, void of nutrients, under heat lamps. I would much rather not be forced to pay for a buffet for my entire family which would bring us back for the games monthly.

name: Adria Guldjord
text: My son had a blast here. Okay, I loved the go carts! So fun for both adults and kids!

name: Ashley
text: Absolutely love this place.  We had a blast!  Fun for all ages.  A bit expensive but worth it!

name: Britt Family
text: We had fun....wish halogen was 3 times instead of one time, but everything else was awesome

name: Heather Grizzle
text: We went on Wednesday and the games cost half of the usual amount to play-- two kiddos under 7 were highly entertained for the couple of hours we spent here!

name: Tim Caywood
text: Amazing place for kids at a decent price so much to do and play. Decent food as well salad bar is delicious!!!

name: Marvin Thessen
text: This is a great place to spend a few hours with your family. There is a huge buffet. All sorts of pizza, pasta and for the kids tater tots, hot dogs, mac n chz. If there is something you want and its not out on the buffet, they will make it for you. Thats some great service. Be sure to tip.

name: Judy Souder
text: Every one was polite and helpful and made my grandsons birthday very special

name: Cassy Drake
text: A little hot inside but tons of fun for the kids AND adults.

name: Sped Wagon
text: Very good place to take the kids, but isn't the most clean place

name: melissa fowler
text: Fun and nice place just the food isnt great.

name: TEXAS BABE*
text: Lots of different games to play, a couple of rides. My family and I have fun here everytime we go. I gave 4 stars because the food is not all that great. But the fun is. Pricing is reasonable.

name: Joy Marshall
text: Attended a meeting  at the Amazing Pizza Machine receiving outstanding service.  Great meeting space and food, therefore the facility is not just for kids.

name: Wes Blaha
text: My kids live this place and the buffet is pretty good. It's basically the exact same buffet as Valentino's. There's things for kids of all ages but it's not cheap so bring your wallet. Your kids will live it though.

name: Pistol Pat
text: Always a fun time at the pizza machine, I'm 28 and still makes me feel like a kid when I'm there good times!

name: Eduwiges Santana R
text: I love this place,this a place where you can expend a very good family time.

name: Michael Clark
text: Pretty fantastic, very clean. Nice staff and a ton of activities to do with the family. Super nice time today and really enjoyed it.

name: Peter Haze Haring
text: Another fun family experience. Always a good place when looking for something to do on hot day. Cool all the around.

name: Jay Perry
text: Fun for families

name: sarah martin
text: So much to do for every child of all ages. Amazing food and selection. A little pricey but worth it if your spending all day three

name: fishercat17
text: The kids love this place!  The food is OK, but the restaurant part is kept very clean, probably the cleanest buffet I've ever seen.  The rides and games are where this place shines.  Make sure that you go online and become a VIP (free) for a discount on prices.

name: Jordan Lukow
text: Overall a good experience, but the facilities are starting to show age and wear. The parking lot is getting pretty worn out and some of the machines are missing parts, don't function properly, or are helds together by zip ties. The food was just ok. I do have to compliment the service. Everyone working was very polite, prompt, and helpful. Small gripes overall. Would go again and would recommend to friends.

name: Cecilia Sandoval
text: Awesome place for kids and updates are super fun. Food could use some change though.

name: Monte Rice
text: We had a lot of family fun here. The food was great. I highly suggest having kids birthday's here! It was a little on the pricey side but so worth it!

name: Brett N
text:
My 2 kids and I have gone many times and love it each time. This past trip, we had lost a card that holds the tickets of my sons and Renee and Jason both took my problem and made it theres without hesitation (may 29th, 2019).  With some luck (buy your meals and game tokens online, it's easy to find transactions that way, people!) and some digging, they found his old card (10k + tickets hes saved for a few years) and transferred it to his new one!
Good food, available staff, lots of games, rides and clean tables/food area.

name: Samantha Boyerman
text: My kids loved it the workers were great and food was fresh

name: Chris Beasley
text: It’s a pretty decent place to throw a party. The kids enjoy it but expect to throw down some money.

name: RIVERA EAR
text: It's an amazing place and I give 5 stars to the friendly staff, food and games. But they serve alcohol in this place, they should let people drink in a place that is considered to be family friendly.  But besides that our family and I had an amazing time playing in this place.

name: Suzanne Yancey
text: I normally don't review places like this, but I have to say, this place kind of rocks guys. The buffet was spotless and the hundreds of tables were promptly bussed. My kids had a blast on all the games, and the staff was on point. Plenty of machines to use.

name: Katherine Hicks
text: The food is trash and the tables were dirty.  When you know your busiest times are the weekend have more staff available for cleanliness.  The games were great.  Just eat before you go.

name: Ty Kuenning
text: This place was pathetic. Granted, I'm not a child looking to play games all day, but even my child step-brothers were unimpressed. The food was subpar and I regret spending my money here.

name: Chinwendu Nwinye
text: Food is trash. Games are fun. Pricey fr fr.

name: Jeff Hayward
text: My daughter granddaughter love this place. But I don't care for the food. I think they leave it out too long.

name: Erik b
text:
I really hate going here but my daughter likes it.   Buffet food is about as low a quality as you can get, it does have a decent variety.

Since everyone has to get the buffet to get in a trip to this place can get expensive.

name: JEFF PETERS
text: A really fun place for the family to eat and play arcade games. A buffet meal. Bumper Cars, small roller coaster, a tiny tots playground, games of chance and skills, they are all at the Amazing Pizza Machine.

name: Ty Larson
text: My boy really likes it. They changed the ride rule for the little cars to require greater height and that the singles can't ride at the same time as adult with kids so my boy missed his chance to ride.

name: Don DeLaMare
text: Good food and fun games. My favorite was the ice cold milk. 😁 Fun games too. Some very kind Omaha person let us have his all day pass and the girls had a blast. Their favorite games were guitar hero and one of the racing games.

name: Brian Cooper
text: The place is awesome everything a kid could want all the way down to the food packages can be a little pricey but you'll get your money's worth

name: pika gear
text: First let me say that my children would give this place 4-5 stars so if you have kids take the rest of my review with a grain of salt. I am not a fan of the food here. The food is heavily processed, bland, and far from what I enjoy eating. The salad bar does offer a little balance to this. The games are geared toward young children and do entertain them but some are a little run down and can be out of order. They did offer a military discount for veterans but changed it to active duty only last time we were there. Overall if they put a little more into the food and upkeep the place would be better for me.

name: Mike & Steph Goodwin
text: This is a fun family place.  We went for our sons Birthday.  Even though we didn't have a party booked, they still recognized it was his Birthday.  We spent at least 4hours.

name: Jörg Henkel
text:
Always a sure-fire hot to take the kids to. ;)
Also has a nice salad bar during lunch!

name: Becky Bruns
text: This is a great place...  It's worth the 2 1/2 hr. drive. Both my boys 14 & 8 love coming and have since they were little... great Buffett... we come and eat 2x once for lunch and then again for dinner... the ultimate pass is amazing and keeps the kids busy. Well worth the money, even if you don't eat.... Glad to have this AMAZING  place!

name: Jason Druskis
text: Pretty decent gluten free pizza which can be hard to find if you have allergies otherwise there food selection is great. There are plenty of fun games as well. Staff is always friendly and very accommodating. I have noticed that the ticket booth can get easily overwhelmed and cleanliness could be better as well.

name: Carrie Hansel
text:
New ride not intended for older children
Or adults. But still a fun and exciting place.

name: Anthony Gardner
text: They have some great game additions, dampened slightly by the old, crusty ones (especially for smaller children.) And the buffet is tasty!

name: Margie Raymond
text: Went my granddaughters birthday party here. The food was good and the kids had fun celebrating

name: Tom Becker
text: Family fun with a price.  I took my son here today just to have a bit of fun.  As this was our first time going, we were not aware that you cant walk in and just pay for points to play games.  Parents be warned that they will charge you both a child and an adult buffet, even if you weren't interested in eating here.  Also, the bathrooms were a disaster, which makes you question every game handle and ride.  Bring extra hand sanitizer!  I turned our card in at the end as I have no interest in bringing my son here again.

name: Justin Whitney
text: Good for kids. Over priced a bit but kids love it.

name: time lord
text: The pizza is great for children, adults  was ok. The price is good. Will come back .

name: Mike Bohnenkamp
text: For the price you pay, the food has gone down hill..some of it I wouldn't let my dog eat. I know that is not the main thing for them but, come on folks.  All the games seemed to be working for us. Just seems over priced for food and games to me.

name: Dave Evans
text: So much fun!!! Spent 3 1/2 hours in the blink of an eye

name: Mallory Haskin
text: We came for dinner and got my kids a 90 minute unlimited play and rides. You may think that the 40 bucks isnt worth the unlimited but I'm sure you can get your money's worth. We loved loved loved this place. The food wasnt amazing but who cares. We were there to have fun and we definitely did. Will for sure be coming back as soon as we can.

name: M Wilson
text: We went here with our grandson and had the best time ever. We were afraid the food wouldn't be that good but it really wasn't bad. We had a great time. We will definitely go again

name: Mirella Sanchez
text: Big place for. Kids but food. Was. Cold n Old  was n slow day maybe  cause of that .

name: J B
text: Very misleading with their card packages and buffet.  First of all the buffet was very basic (not worth it) and then the amount of games that the unlimited card allowed was less than 15.  The race track is very lame for even a 5 year old.  Most of the games were ticket producing games.  Tell total cost for a family of 4 was $131.00. Not even worth it...take your money and spend it elsewhere.

name: Jack Purdy
text: Would recommend going occasionally but not regularly. The reason is that it is a medium facility and after a while it gets kind of repetitive and boring. I would recommend going maybe for 90-120 minutes sessions maybe once every year.

name: Merrill Wiggins
text: Fun spot! Nice selection @ the buffet, but the food wasn't as good as usual. Seems a little pricey, but kids loved getting to play lots of games for a full hour & a half!

name: Karl Okolotowicz
text: Great place for a night with the family. The food is pretty good as it is valentino's. The prices are a little high for the evening, but the kids have a great time. They also offer a slight discount if you join the club and get free buffet on your kids birthday. They do require either a game pass or buffet to enter and stay. They offer a good selection of game packages for everyone. They offer go carts, bumper cars, vr games and laser tag along with the traditional video and ticket games. Overall a little expensive but fun to do every now and then

name: Cyan Galaxy85
text: I love it IRA an amazing place to go and I love the ninja turtle arcade game there

name: Richard Holter
text: Little pricey but the kids love it.  Buffet is good but could use a few more adult choices.  Pizza and pasta is good.  Good entertainment value.

name: N O
text: We celebrate our kids bday there every year. Kids sure love this place

name: Milly East
text: Food was great ! I went around 6pm on a Sunday and it wasn't too busy at all .  Only downer is that the 4 rides offered wasn't open at the same time so we had to keep waiting. Other than that we had a blast . Would highly recommend getting the unlimited play .The play points go really fast the fun games are about 5-6 points each . Will be going back very soon

name: Scott Thomsen
text: Great⁉Except alcohol has NO place in a "mainly" child environment. Hey! I like a beer now & then, but if you think you need to get your buzz on while your kid runs around, then drive them home half blitzed⁉Well your a problem to society. Try getting some exercise keeping up with your child getting in some good quality time with what this Great establishment has to offer.... And to thee establishment, come on? Really? I am disappointed you even offer alcohol. Even for the extra revenue. I would prefer if being more kid friendly by not finding left behind beer bottles allover, thus not providing the safe place I would expect for a Family-friendly center. 5 stars if you remove alcohol.

name: Jessica Raymond
text: It is so expensive to come here. It's definitely better suited for younger kids. My youngest is 11, and preferred Dave and Buster's over here. However, the little kids we were with loved it!

name: janie Rinehart
text: It was a great time! The only reason for 3 stars rather than 5 is due to the prices/packages being rather misleading. I bought the unlimited rides AND games for my daughter only to find out an hour in that the unlimited games was only for the video games that do not reward prizes/tickets....you know the ones that kids actually WANT TO PLAY! I feel that is something they should thoroughly explain BEFORE taking the I believe  $34.95 for the package. I most definitely wouldn't have purchased that package as my 9 year old daughter has zero interest in playing race car games or games similar to that. I find it very hard to believe that this isn't a constant issue of parents returning to the counter going "wait a second...." "why are my unlimited games costing points?" In fact I got my answer to the question by listening to the answer given to the gentlemen in front of me asking the exact same thing. I spent at least an hour on-line reviewing packages and looking at the activities with my daughter before deciding that was where we were going and STILL did not know I wasn't getting what I thought I was for my money. If you're looking for a fun place with reasonable prices and no "catches" I suggest Fun Plex, granted there is no buffet and the food they do have is expensive the price of admission is cheaper, and unlimited everything REALLY MEANS UNLIMITED!! They also have daily deals, coupons, and a special twilight price. Just dollar menu it before or after going and you will have a great time without breaking the bank and or feeling cheated

name: Venis Wallace
text: Great place for the kids! The pizza was not to my or my husband taste but they have a great salad bar with almost everything you like! I also loved the fact that you are able to pick your table and get you're own drinks.

name: Ivan Reyna
text: Great price and friendly staff

name: DistinctiveUsername
text: Saw my worst nightmare come true but other than that it was pretty great

name: Cornhusker Yankee
text:
Very disappointed with buffet. Mash potatoes didn't taste like mash potatoes. Salad was questionable. Baked potatoes were so cold that butter didn't even melt. At least the kids enjoyed the game room.

Was here for several of the grandsons' birthday parties. The food was very good then. This time it was a very big disappointment.

name: Tristin The game master
text: it's been an almost exactly the same experience since I was a kid ever since I ever first stepped into one of the go-karts I was instantly go-karts though the track may be small over there it's better than having it outside on a rainy day food is great although I would recommend pasta with alfredoit is also an all-you-can-eat buffet with places for parties I don't know how much they are since I've never been to one although they may have new things it still has that old no old nice family friendly funny although the new vibe saying his guns don't time we went weren't working I highly enjoyed the VR experience I would definitely give this six stars if I could.

name: Keith Kansiewicz
text: This is a great place to take your friends and family for fun games, entertainment and a decent variety of food and drink options. The food is served buffet style and they have themed dining rooms as well as party rooms. The games and activities are great for all ages.

name: Joe Jones
text: Amazing? Haha, maybe. Great? Sure. I never thought I could love pizza again. Never did I give the priecieved notion that I'd ever enjoy another pizza again. But man, wow, I have to tell you that this is good pizza.

name: Amber Alexander
text: Awesome place, price is high but some discounts available on their website.

name: Helen Beasley
text: Great place for kids to enjoy. Nice indoor fun. If you have kids you must certainly visit this place.

name: Nyssa Mother of Voids
text: Food was good, games had differing point/token systems that needed extra explaining, but the rides were fun.

name: Terry Hedrick
text: The kids had a blast and so did the big kids (adults-lol).

name: Dean Sime
text: Had a lot of fun. Equipment overdue for repairs

name: Dillon Forster
text: They have a lot of good options, as far as packages you can get. The selection of food is pretty good. The salad bar is always stocked. As for the quality, it's pretty good. They try to keep the pizza fresh.

name: Hornet mobile
text: Great place to have fun but there food isn't the best.

name: Susan Fritz
text: Great place for kids. Buffet was surprisingly good.

name: Ravin Curtis
text: My daughter always have a  ball,  thanks

name: writethatgirl Newlife
text: Grandkids love the place ~ its rather difficult to watch a group of kids as there are so many rooms that divide the place up making it impossible to oversee them all. The entrance/exit is large and also cut off from the rest of it pretty much so unless you plan to keep everyone together (which is impossible in a place like this) it can be stressful. Chucky Cheese isn't much better but at least they match hand stamps of children to adults when leaving for safety.

name: Christopher Thompson
text: Place wasn't terrible. The food was awful it was like one of those kid cartoon pizza places where you know you shouldn't eat it but your going too.  Some of the games are pretty cool like an old asteroids with guns that's a kewl twist laser tag blah blah blah.. all in all not bad

name: Courtney Holmes
text: variety of games and small rides for kids. buffet isn’t the greatest but it’s not the worst either. my son had a blast today and every time he’s been. the staff is friendly courteous and very helpful.

name: Steve Isom
text: The place gets 2 stars because the games are great but the food is absolutely terrible. And that's coming in with low expectations. You would think as high as the price is they would raise the food quality.  Going to give Chuck E. Cheese another try or just take the kids for the games.

name: Brenda Meyer
text: Had both of my granddaughter birthday there. We all had lots of fun. Can't wait until we go again

name: Edward Sosa
text: This place is very nice inside but bery little food/pizza to choose from. A place like this should have a great variety of all you can eat pizza .

name: Meghan Terry
text: We purchased an unlimited birthday package got accused of sharing cards the young attendant yelled at my friend's daughter we got the manager involved he said he would check the cameras he could not tell the way she spoke to her . Needless to say nothing was resolved I will never spend $500 on a birthday party to be treated like this or my guest.  The male attendant at the go karts and the lady at the frog game today clearly need classes on how to treat customers.

name: Mathew Johnson
text: Don't visit the pizza machine in hopes of having any sort of good food. The food is horrible, but the games are worth while I suppose for a typical arcade. The prices are too steep, but I feel like that's the norm in this type of industry anymore. Kids are running everywhere and with little manners, but if you're looking for some time at a classic arcade, it is worth it for some. :)

name: Steve Highland
text: Pizza has gotten a lot better and it was very fun

name: Zainab A
text: Fun place to visit with your kids.

name: Jeremy Redmond. JBR
text: Took my daughter there for the first time for her birthday we all had a great time and food was delicious

name: Zach Scallorn
text: Probably some of the most nasty food I have ever had, super salty, pizza is pretty much all bread.  Everything has a weird taste to it.

name: Michael Torok
text: Surprisingly clean for how crazy it gets on a Saturday. Impressed with the staff. Other people not paying attention to their children makes this a 4 star, but that can't be helped.

name: Tyler Hamell
text: Good place with good food. Parking lot needs work though

name: Nick Terjak
text: Massively expensive. Two adults and 3 kids was $160! Pizza was ok. Plenty of games. The most fun I believe we had was the laser tag. All and all was fun. But it's so expensive

name: JJ Andregg
text: The new ride was crazy... Food was delicious 😋

name: Dan Teet
text: Took my son for his 9th birthday. Had so much fun. The new HoloGate is amazing!

name: Christina Risinger
text: Great venue!  We had a cubscout lock in there, the crew was very accommodating and patient with us.  Lots of games, go cart races, laser tag, a mini rollercoaster, the frog hopper ride, even a little bowling alley & bumper cars.  Food too of course.  Great for all ages.

name: Kat Palmer
text: It's not cheap but it is lots of fun for kids and adults. The food isn't amazing but it's a lot better than what I've had at other similar places and they do have a good selection. There are lots of different games and a few fun rides.

name: Megan Valenti
text: Great place for family fun!

name: Jason Perry
text: The game area is cool and the food is what you would expect, good but not great. If not for the manager that lied to us repeatedly about the buffet closing time so she could shutdown early I would have rated it higher. We showed up at 7:50 and was told we had till 8:30 to eat only to be told by the manager after we got our first plates and sat down that it closed at 8 and always has and the guy upfront said he told us 8. After talking to him again he showed me the sign on the counter saying it closed at 8:30. I don't like being lied to especially such a pathetic easily debunked lie.

name: ThePelos377
text: Fun for the keys... Very pricey! Can't enter without buying a gaming pass or a buffet pass.

name: jacob jackman
text: Food is ok most staff dont know what they are even doing

name: Shana Morse
text: Had a lot of fun. The staff is amazing! Feel like its germ filled fun!

name: Issa L
text: Love this place for winter birthday parties! You pay a 50.00 deposit and can pay as you go up to the date of the party! This is the only place I have found like that! And they are very understanding of changing dates and number of guests! Food is not very good, salad bar is OK, and dessert is pretty good.

name: Ryan Albano
text: The food is alright, but is by no means something that would draw you to this place. The games are fun, but it is pricey to get in the door! This is a place that we go to maybe once a year and always have fun when we do... but between the price and food quality I am never the one to suggest going back.

name: crystal paige-doty
text: Great buffet, decently priced if you only get the buffet.  Great fun for the whole family, but a little pricey for the games.

name: cheri boettger
text: Food is good. Kids love the games

name: Chelsea F
text: As with most places like this, it's over-priced and the food's not great. But there's so much to do! We had fun and would definitely go again.

name: Ashley Beckius-Dozier
text: My daughter who is autistic loved it there

name: Laney Mullen
text: So the place is huge. The food is good for a children's buffet which we all understand going in is going to be almost all carbs. You have to buy the buffet. If you go online before you come and buy your package there you'll end up saving a very decent chunk of change...BUT you have to sign up as a VIP so prepare for junk email. (STILL worth the savings) This place is exactly the same as it has always been. No new rides. Some games have changed but I'd like to see some freshness.

name: JOEY Gaines
text: Average food.  Clean for the chaos.  Kids have fun.

name: TROY LICHTENBERG
text: It was a great place to eat.

name: Michaela Allan
text: The kids always have a blast, the food is always fresh and the service is great. Good birthday parties!

name: Chad Jansen
text: Great place to bring the kids for a good time and to tire them out!  The pizza however is terrible, definitely get the buffet.  The buffet is actually pretty good.  The overall experience can get to be a little pricey though.

name: Gail Holtsclaw
text: so much fun. lots of great deals threw the week. great place to go with family and friends. somthing for everyone. lots of food to choose from.

name: Denise Tibbitts
text: The buffet was pretty bad. Under par for quality of food. The games were fun but a few of them had to be restarted because it would work when we tried to use them.

name: Mr.Demetrius
text: I had a great time.  The pizza boofay was on point !

name: Kaylin Middleton
text: Very fun spot for the whole family. Pizza is pretty good. Better than cici's. They have plenty of options other than pizza as well in case you're just not feeling all the bread and sauce. When we went in "free food February" we got 2 adult buffets for 5 each with the purchase of a $20 play card per adult buffet which we were going to get anyway so it worked out really well for our family of 3 to eat and play for quite a while without breaking the bank. They have go carts, lazer tag, bumper cars, a small rollercoaster for all ages, and the "puddle jumper" drop coaster for the little ones that isn't scary at all that my 3 yr old just couldn't go on enough. I also saw a virtual reality first person shooter type game that I didn't play but it did look pretty fun.

name: Nate Woodard
text: Food can be kinda hit and miss. Staff is generally quite friendly.

name: iot Xaler
text: Would give a five star, it just has to get better with the buffet part

name: Alex Otto
text: If you like games and food, this is  the place to play! Its expensive for groups but for an individual the cost is moderate. There are so many games to play, good luck doing it in an hour or two!

name: Linda Ritenour
text: Food was only ok. Lots of fun games but expect to spend a lot of money

name: Kyle A Kotecki
text: Always a lot of fun and the buffet is pretty good, it just seems a little pricey for a place you should take the whole family.

name: Andy h
text: Great place for the whole family to have fun. There are some rides for the kiddos, loads of video and ticket games, and there are go carts and Lazer tag also. On Wednesday you play all games for half price and the buffet offers a variety of food.

name: Em Walker
text:
It's fun when you have the time and money. Try to go during non-peak hours though. So much easier to navigate, and less sensory overload for parents and children. Not to mention, little to no lines for Go Carts,  the buffet,  etc.
In the eating areas,  the tables do sometimes tend to be a bit messy for a longer time than one would think,  even during off hours.
We go once a year though,  just due to price and while a buffet sounds nice,  there is never a big selection of food.

name: David Brunmeier
text: Love to watch the grandkids play

name: Bill Luster
text: Fun for kids decent pizza buffet

name: Neil Barels
text: Kiddos had fun.

name: Miranda Stark
text:
Never again.
The odor of this place is horrible (mix of urine and mildew maybe?). There was a domestic in the middle of the arcade and we had to take the kids away - because you know, safety. Zero chance I will step into this building again.

name: Boss Lady
text: Fun with the kids. Food was not stocked fresh. Was just about what everybody before said it was mmmmkay.

name: Alex C
text: Amazing. I'm 21 and still want to go here for my birthday

name: kent thorne
text: It is fun, lot of game variety. Food is terrible, but what can you expect for what it is. Our kids always have fun and enjoy the different themed dining areas.

name: Angel Eustice
text: The food is horrible but the kids had fun with the games

name: Welinda GRuak
text: My girls love the place

name: Shar'nae Brown
text: My son loves going and having a fun day here. Great customer service.

name: Scott Thomas
text:
Buffet is never fresh no matter when you go. a good chunk of ticket games that are used by the time cards didnt work.

Better option is to go to Dave and busters

name: SJO14 Ovalle
text: Great place to eat. Fun for the whole family

name: Ln C
text: Pretty disappointed $120 and half the games eat your play points then if you are lucky enough to find someone to get you help you stand there for ever then at the end of our trip I let two people know how disappointed I was they literally just starred at me like I was speaking a foreign language so I ended up kust walking out thanks for the disappointing evening and lack of care by staff that the games were not working

name: Ahmed Rageh
text: Very good place for kids. It has lots of funny amazing stuff. It has an open poffet as well which contains pizza, pasta, peverages and dessert

name: Kris Kahlandt
text: Good time, probably not the best place to bring kids ages 2-4

name: bella lieberth
text: Games are rigged,  mini car need better supervision.

name: Aidan W
text: Good memories, the staff where not very enthusiastic but that's ok.

name: Emma Barnes
text: We went there and it looked fun but prices are too high and you have to eat at the buffet to get access.

name: Bobby Neal
text: Pizza Machine really needs to develop a process to let people come in to just play the games. text: *long sorry* My fiancé and I wanted to celebrate our daughter’s 1st birthday here. We booked our event for $206! No issue. Until we get there and had to share a dining room with 2 other families. We had a tiny table to put our cake and presents on and 3 small tables pushed together with our daughters name put on pieces of paper to show it was reserved! When we went to ask about what had happened to our room, the manager (who was very rude and seemed annoyed) told us the rooms aren’t guaranteed to anyone it’s first come first serve only. I had booked the party 2 1/2 months ahead of time😡 and the lady I had spoken with a week prior to the event made it clear we’d have a room! Then proceeded to say I got a confirmation email with rules but I didn’t receive rules, just a confirmation about the party date and time. He then pulled the rule book out and no where did it state first come first serve rooms and others will be placed in a dining hall. Had we known, we wouldn’t have booked there. The main reason we did was to get a private room. If we wanted to share, we would’ve gone to chunk e cheese. They have a horrible communication ordeal going on here. Not very throughout and clear either. Soooo not worth $200...the only enjoyable part was the rides.

text: My kids had a great time at the amazing pizza machine. It was very pricey. My wife and I got basic packages so we could go on rides with the kids. Oh, and included.in the price was an additional 50 cents for each game card. They had military discount, but only for the card holder, it was $5.00 of free gameplay. The food was ok. I got a salad to start and everything was good except the dressing was watery. Then I got the fettechine noodles and they were cold. The pizza was pretty good. They had a lot of desserts, I got an apple pizza pie and it was really good. I also had nachos, and the cheese was watery.  The soda pop selection was great and the pop was good.  They also had slushies. The main ride for the kids was broken. The go carts we're great, but wasted a lot of time off your card as the helpers we're very, very slow.the bathrooms were a mess and needed to be cleaned, the one I went I to had toliet paper all over it. For the games that rewarded tickets, the tickets went directly on your card which was nice and they had awesome prizes! I am very particular and want to get what I paid for.  The food could have been better, but overall, the kids had fun.

text:
APM has always been the lesser version of Dave and Buster's, IMO. D&B is suited for adults and has an awesome food/drink menu, but the Omaha location doesn't have the floor space of other locations I've been to across the country.

APM is vast, has decent games, and has a pretty decent buffet. Admittedly, they could use an interior refresh and the parking lot resembles the lunar surface. Yes, it's spendy, but the buffet is included with admission, and they also serve alcohol. The kids have a better time at APM because they have kid-specific games and small rides, and the buffet has all the things they like, whereas D&B may require more menu browsing and their table service is hit & miss.

name: Jenepher Lane
text:
This had been a 5 star place. My husband and I live in Lincoln but love(d) to eat at Fudd's. That is until tonight.

My husband ordered the 3 cheese 1/3 lb burger (med-well) and I got the ribeye steak sandwich (med). This is our usual order here.

Tonight, the toppings bar was scarce and pitiful. The tomato bays were empty except for 2 end pieces. The pickles, banana peppers and onions were completely dried out. The lettuce was warm to the touch.

On top of that, both of the hot cheeses (jalapeno asks regular) were near empty. The photo is of the regular after 2 pumps. The jalapeno one gave little bits in an air burst but they were obviously near empty.

Upon receiving the food, the first thing we noticed was different buns (no big deal). Upon closer inspection, the buns weren't just grilled lightly, they were crunchy. Once seated (we passed on the toppings), the first thing I noticed was the amount of fat on my sandwich (see images). There were no knives avail so I had to use 2 forks to separate the edible portion from the fat. Now I know it's a ribeye so there will be some but this was beyond excessive. After I seperated one portion of meat from the glob my husband suggested a photo. The pic with the steak mostly intact was after the removal of one small piece equal to the bulb of meat in the bottom of the photo. The other photo is of the collective fat/grissle that remained after nibbling though what we edible.

Now if you think it can't get any worse... Hang on! When one of the female associates behind the counter looked in the hot cheese pots, she announced to the other associates that they "just needed to add more water", so adding insult to injury.

The only bright spot of the meal was the fries. As usual, those did not disappoint (unlike everything else).

We contemplated dessert but didn't want to risk the shakes being "watered down"

I/we don't plan on returning any time soon.

text: I have amazing memories of going to Fuddruckers as a kid in places like Hiton Head, Atlanta and New Jersey. This franchise unfortunately falls way short. It could have been a bad night where a couple of employees called in at the last minute, and this was my first time visiting this store, but there were literally 4 people staffing the entire restaurant on a not-so-slow Sunday evening. First off, both freestyle Coke machines were out of no less than half of their beverage options, including all of the signature Fuddruckers drinks. Next, as I looked for a table, half of them were not bussed, and half of them had empty napkin dispensers. I found a table next to the window, but apparently the manager or owner lives next  to the store in a large RV which completely blocks the view of the outside. Then my food was ready, the hot cheese dispenser was low, and I had to wait for a staff member to spoon me out a serving. As I sat and ate, one busser came out without a tray or tub and grabbed like one plate and two cups from one of the tables. When I finished eating and headed out, never to return, I passed a for sale sign in the lobby advertising used chairs. I was embarrassed for the great Fuddruckers brand as I drove away.  I guess the food was good, but it was overshadowed by the experience.

text:
I love Fuddruckers.  I had not been able to get back to one for a long time, but was disappointed by my experience here.  This location was slow to take my order, had to wait to get a manager involved for basic math when the cashier accidentally entered $50 into the computer (instead of the $20 I handed the person), was slow to get our food out, grossly overcooked my burger, they don't have Hellman's mayonnaise anymore, and even though the restaurant was nearly empty, somehow most of the tables were dirty.

The other strange thing was the music level... I love loud music, but not when I'm trying to talk with people.  I tried to find the quietest table I could find that was clean, but it didn't matter; the volume was up so high that I could not hold a conversation with the person across from me.  I finally got annoyed enough to go ask them to turn it down a little, and they did.

For my money, I think I'll just head west a little bit and go to Red Robin, or I'll just stick with going to the Sioux Falls, SD Fuddruckers location when I'm in town.  :)

name: Patrick Hayes
text: Werner Park's Christmas light show was phenomenal. It was the first big light show for our kids and they loved the synchronized lights/music. Cars flowed freely and it was large enough that it gave the experience some depth.

name: Cathy Enoviso
text: Fun place to take your family! Make sure to check out Santa's Rock N Lights during the holiday season 🎅

name: Jennifer Dein
text:
Need to go!!
I suggest date night or family with some hot cocoa!!
BEAUTIFUL 😁

name: Jake Farrell
text: Fun place.  Great atmosphere!

name: Stephanie H
text: They had a awesome light show that you drove through with Christmas lights. The only problem is is there were $5 signs everywhere that were left up from and they normally have baseball games. They should have taken down because the price was about 24 $25 per car.

name: Nick Zuck
text: Went to the annual Christmas Lights show and it was excellent. Definitely worth the price of admission. Look forward to going back for a baseball game soon.

name: Daniel Hendrickson
text: The lights and music was amazing. However, we got in line at 7 pm, it's now 8:45 and we are still in line. We are hoping by 9:30 we can get in. The lines are coming from 3 directions all merging at a turnabout.

name: Mary Arnold
text: We saw the wonderful Christmas lights it was very well organized and beautifully set up. We will be happy to go again.

name: Damon Samuel
text: Spectacular Light Display....with great photo opportunities...Beautifully done for the Holidays!!

name: John Felger
text: Regards to the Santa's Rockn Lights. This was well worth going to see. Dinosaurs, dancing ginger bread, singing Santas, light tunnels, nut cracker soldiers, reigndeer, trains, peacocks, and so much more! All sync to music played over FM radio station. Great music selection too!

name: James Newman
text: Was a stinking nightmare to get into the light show. 3 hour wait and the staff had no idea what they were doing. The rental sheriff deputy's were yelling at people. Its christmas time with my kids so I dont need that attitude. Do a better job and then be upset. The show was very nice and the only reason why they rate any stars in my opinion.

name: Deb Lane
text: They are doing a xmas light show that u drive thru,  fantastic

name: brooklynn leming
text: Wonderful!!!!! Love the Santa Rockin Lights display this year. Especially the dinosaurs!!! It's become a new family tradition even before covid .

name: James Gittins
text: Great Christmas displays!!

name: Deb Boan
text: Went to the rocking lights! Allot of fun

name: Katherine Noden
text: Rockin Santa Christmas was a very nice event during this crazy pandemic year. Thank you for hosting.

name: Pedro Tellez
text:
ICC Car / BIKE Show.. Awesome Machines..
Respectfully
"P"

name: Jeff G.
text: The Christmas lights were nice, but the price was high ($25). Had to wait in line for 45 minutes to get in, overall it wasn't worth the price.

name: Mike Kasworm
text:
Fun place with a very family friendly atmosphere. Parking is very available, and even "cheap" parking is pretty close on a regular night.

The beer is cold, and the food is... ballpark grade. Beer choice is very limited, but I guess one should expect and appreciate a "cold and yellow" beer at the ballpark.

The event staff were great when our company worked with them, it was nice to feel like we had a real help in putting on our event!

name: Steven Telesford
text: Went to the inaugural Union Omaha owls match. They removed the baseball mound to accommodate the soccer pitch. For the first match there was a lot of fans ready to support the team. During Covid, masks were required whenever you weren't at you seat and everyone was following these rules.

name: Charlie Reynolds
text: Very nice Minor League park.  Stuff for kids... great family value.

name: Liz Harrison
text: Very nice lights easy to get through.

name: Robert Gosse
text: Had a blast here watching a double header. Again, this is a place that when we are in the area we always make a point to spend a little time here. The food is very good with a wide selection. Staff is very friendly and very helpful. Can't stress enough how much of a good time we have here. Very family friendly. Fireworks display on the 4th of July is the best.

name: Cory Bennett
text: A great way to watch some quality baseball. The field is a bit of a drive (still like it close to the old Omaha area) but it is a well played out park. On hot summer days with mid-day games the sun can be a bit much as there is very little shade. This last time splurged for the VIP seats (which were still quite affordable) and had a great time.

name: Melissa Swanson
text: So much to do than just watch fantastic baseball.  The only thing that we were surprised about was the $5 parking.

name: Josh Boller
text: Great place for a game....or run or what ever they got going that day.

name: Hayley Kidder
text: The Santa holiday light show was awesome.

name: Chris Johnson
text: Went Union Omaha Soccer game.  Very clean venue and well run.

name: stacy rakosky
text: Santa's Rockin Light Show was amazing

name: Liz Leeds
text: Great place to watch a game. Fireworks show was also great

name: David Wiese
text: The Rocking Santa lights was awesome!

name: Jb Jn
text: Light show with the Christmas lights was cool

name: Lesa Adams
text: Can't say enough about this place! Clean, friendly park staff. Love how close you feel to the field regardless where you sit. Concession staff is always excellent.

name: H M
text: If your wanting a fun place for the family this is the place for you. It’s a very clean ballpark and for the most part the staff is typically nice. Every place has its bad apple. Lol They use to shoot out more shirts now they may throw out from the dugout  4-6 maybe so that’s a bummer. The main reason I marked it a 4 is sooo tired every time we go there is so many people hoping seats. Meaning they buy berm tickets but they literally will set in other people sets. We watched a family move 4 times cause they kept setting in people sets. If you’re lucky you will catch the fireworks show 👍

name: Adam Gehringer
text: The Union omaha soccer game was a blast! We had a great time!

name: Marvin Schulz
text: Great environment for family. Excellent seating for watching events.

name: Nora Forsythe
text: Just beautiful, my granddaughter loved it!!

name: Brandee Otto
text: Who doesn't love baseball?  Great place to catch up with friends or to bring the whole family. Park is well maintained.

name: Curtis Mulcahy
text: Fun time with family but food is somewhat expensive.

name: Dillon Forster
text: went for a late night photo shoot. but I hear that the baseball games are pretty good. and their 4th of July fireworks show is something to see

name: Jamie Leeper
text: A superb experience for the family. Reasonably priced, lots for the kids to do, and not a bad seat in the house.  We got the added bonus of the Star Wars/ Cinco de Mayo fireworks!

name: Richard Rogers
text: Ran Cornfield to Cornfield live today. Well done event.

name: Tony Hemmer
text: Great place for family time!

name: Amanda Busch
text: Tons to keep the little one busy while also being able to enjoy the game.  Would definitely recommend to anyone!

name: Dawn Malcolm
text: Great park. Good seating,good food, good fun

name: Mark S
text: Excited about Union Omaha Soccer team and season  tickets!

name: Jess Nicol
text: Not always a huge sports fan to be honest, but I absolutely love baseball here. You can't have baseball without beer and thursdays they have thirsty thursdays! 2 dollar beers not as big as the one pictured though. Ha! They also offer a military discount for tickets!

name: Dan D
text: Fun, family friendly ballpark even the dog is welcomed! All sorts of specials throughout the week so you don't break the bank. Highly recommend going and watching a Stormchasers game on a nice night! "Stir up the Storm"

name: Scott Marsh
text: This is a great place to watch some baseball. The ushers really care. Two seats from me a person took a foul ball to the thigh. The medical team helped the person out. When you hear heads up pay attention! We stayed until the end of the game when most people had went home with the bases loaded with the opposing team top of the ninth and the stormchasers won! Fast paced affordable fun!

name: Andrew Boehm
text: Foods great.  Stadium is clean and seated are comfortable.  Did I mention it's super kid and family friendly.  Baseball is pretty high level!

name: Justin Proett
text: Great day for a ball game!  So much stuff going on.  There's a bunch of different entertainment for the kids and a bunch of different food to eat.  Of course the prices are a little high, but that's expected.

name: Thomas Kurtz
text: Good little ballpark. Food is still ballpark overpriced but I get a chuckle at the hot dog stand's "eat your opponent" special, with a new type of dog styled over whoever the Chasers are playing that day.

name: Donna Barton
text: Beautiful, family park, loads of entertainment, all kinds of foods. Easy drive, easy parking and exit. Only negative, $8 bottled water.

name: Sarah Pittman
text: Lights were beautiful!

name: Kelley Lutjen
text: Great Xmas lights show

name: Brian Swanigan
text: Great Christmas lights!

name: Will badazz
text: Love the off season activities too!!!!

name: Jessica Montaño
text: Love this park. Always clean and nice employees. Bathrooms are sometimes very messy with paper towels and stuff and I found out that they lock stalls to avoid cleaning. Sometimes causing a HUGE line back up.

name: christian clark
text: Picked up trash for the company I work for out here.

name: Margaret Bees
text: Great ballpark!! Very nice friendly staff!!!♥️

name: Alice Olson
text: Good seats, good game but Chasers lost.    Clean and great security staff.

name: Pam Linke
text: The lights & music were fun to watch & hear, entertaining, and promoted the holiday spirit! Loved all the color, flashing lights, different characters & animals, especially the swans, penguins, & santas. We wanted to turn around & go through the park again!

name: William Ryan
text: So happy to have this ball field in papillion. Is fun and it's affordable so the whole family can enjoy!

name: Grace Woebbecke
text: Great baseball at an awesome stadium!! There are plenty of places to buy food, a large gift shop, and even beer.  They host special events and are family friendly.  They have a family fun zone complete with bouncy houses, a carousel, and more!  With very few seats, you are very likely to be able to see the game with no difficulty!  Games are veryenjoyable, and even when it is cold, it is easy to stay warm!

name: Angela Brucks
text: This is awesome to go to

name: Eder Cruz
text: Amazing Christmas lights

name: VL Smith
text: It was Scout night. It was as much fun to watch the kids watch the ball game as it was to just watch the game. Good, clean affordable fun for the whole family.

name: Laura Williams
text: Google has tagged me here. I haven't gone to a game or any event-- but this is an awesome parking lot to take a novice teen driver to practice parking and driving. If the Werner Park folks read this, thanks for not chasing us off!!

name: Jorge Siow
text: Very fun environment that puts you close to the field no matte where you sit. Staff is always friendly and ready to help. Plenty for everyone to do even if they don't like to watch baseball. Lots of good promotions throughout the year

name: Monty Vogel
text: This place is amazing. I love how they make it available for so many other types of events as well (fund raisers, christmas light drive thru).

name: Scott Ryan Corey
text: Great atmosphere and there is a lot for kids to do if they aren't interested in the ballgame.

name: Becky Red
text: Great game with Omaha Chasers and KC Royals. Wow! What an ending.  A bit chilly but the blankets and gloves helped. Fun night for the whole family.  ;-)

name: Martha Hammond
text: The lights were nice although they  didn't have a single nativity display :(

name: Kodi Williamsen
text: Super clean facility, safe and relaxed atmosphere, tasty food/drinks and friendly service. Fireworks and special events all the time! Also sunsets are phenomenal out there!

name: Christina Gagne
text:
Star Wars fans & Fireworks!!! Oh my
Plus the temperature was perfection

name: Greg S
text: My favorite time to go to Werner Park is on a Sunday afternoon when the weather is not too hot. Just to sit back and a very nice and new stadium. It's great sitting back you know watch the game do a little people watching also. I'm going to add some photos to this review.

name: Marcus Gomez
text: This is a nice gem in Papillion, facility is very nice and clean. Kids play area is nice for families. Our company picnic was here and it was very enjoyable.

name: Epyk Adventures
text: Great place for more than just a ball game 😁

name: Dale Trefelner
text: Nice park, clean, enjoy the Beautiful Christmas light show $ 25 dollars per car

name: A Crowd of One
text: 8/7/19. Still, a good experience. I think a kiosk selling Chinese food would be good. Too late for this year, but maybe next. Egg rolls and fried rice.

name: Kile Smith
text: Awesome place to catch a ballgame at a high level. It's a very family friendly park with some of the best promotions in the league.

name: Drew B
text: Great family friendly stadium!  Green space for the kids, good parking and traffic flow, newer facility.  Had a nice time.

name: Kevin M
text:
Great AAA park.  Parking is reasonable and sometimes the dirt lot behind is free which is great.

I've been to several tailgating events in the boxes and the parking lot and they are a great place for a company outing.

Thirsty Thursdays is a must, just bring a DD for the ride home.

Kid friendly and not hard to get in and out of at all.  Bring a glove and catch a foul ball!

name: Harrison Staab
text: Werner Park is a fantastic venue to watch baseball. It's designed to keep you close to the action - there isn't a poor seat in the house. There's lots to do for families with kids, and terrific eating options. The folks who run this must be fun as the promos and activities they do with the crowd make me chuckle. This is a fine minor league park with major league class.

name: Alaina Grisafe
text: The atmoshpere is great, the food is great, and this place brings joy to many people.

name: Alissa Troidl
text: Great facility, very clean. Nice seats, nice staff. I love that you can sit in the grass and there's stuff for kids to do during the games. Love the water misters; it was such a hot evening that we went! Very kid friendly!

name: Zachariahh Petersenn
text: Love going to see the storm chasers and it's nice to have a playground right there to distract kids.

name: Stephanie Jackson
text: Love that they have open seating in the outfield and that huge entertainment area for the kids!! It is a great field and we enjoy it when we are there!

name: Tony
text: A fun & intimate stadium to watch some baseball.

name: Jody Fenton
text: Very excited to pick our seats for Union Omaha!!! Great facility.

name: Brian P
text: Nice park! Clean modern not a bad seat in the park. Lots of food/concessions choices

name: Dan Saalfeld
text:
Wow what an awesome  experience. My first time visiting this new stadium & it won't  be my last one.  My son & I love baseball so having this new stadium is like heaven to us.
Attention to detail & making all fans feel welcome no matter what age. Grands love the playground & the selection for food is fantastic which apeels too the entire family.

name: David Hunke
text: Excellent venue to catch a baseball game, either in the stands or in the outfield berm.  Be prepared to fight the sun for afternoon games, especially in the outfield, but the infield area is basically in the shade for late afternoon/night games.  Food and drink options are good, typical ballpark offerings.

name: Amy Olberding
text: Just experienced our first ever Stormchasers game!! We loved it. Great atmosphere.

name: Nathan Hancock
text: This is a great ballpark to catch a baseball game.  The customer service is excellent.  The extras for the fans are good. The one problem is there concession stand foods are not good or the prices.

name: Kirby Messier
text: The ball park is very well kept. The staff and security are surprisingly courteous! Our view is from row 12 in section 113 this seat is 3rd in the aisle. The chairs were comfortable and the fans were nice as well. There was a fireworks show right after which was really nice.

name: mindy johnson
text: Not a lot of shade areas bathrooms were messy and prices way too much for water or a cheap snack

name: Vincent Gaines
text: Nice little ball park where you enjoy the game up close and still get around without the huge crowds. Plenty of food and drink choices. Not just got dogs and beer anymore. Friendly staff to.

name: Rhonae Lorimor
text: Great field just placed in direct heat and syn for two hours.

name: Matt Pelzer
text: not a bad seat in the house.

name: Charles Anderson
text: Great baseball park that's the right size for a fun overall experience.

name: Gregory Zill
text: Nice triple-A park

name: Caren York
text: Always fun and love the ball game even though we lost

name: Amanda Wise
text: Family fun day with TONS of free activities for kids. Mascots everywhere, including the Easter Bunny. Game announcers really engage crowd with interviews and contests. Carousel, bouncy house and play ground helped balance out the long Stormchasers WIn!

name: Bob LeBaugh
text: A family-friendly and comfortable ball-park

name: Julie Fleming Hicks
text: Bark In The Park was a hit with my furball! Plenty of water was provided for all the pooches, plus poopy bags. And if you wanted to treat your furball to a hot dog they were only 25 cents! We'll definitely be back.

name: T Thomas
text: Had a great time watching the Storm Chasers  with my son tonight!

name: Matt Griffith
text: Fun afternoon / night at Werner Park watching the Stormchasers play the Iowa Cubs. Dogs were allowed in tonight and it was also $0.25 hot dogs. Can't miss!

name: Ken Belew
text: Great parking, beautiful stadium, easy access to concessions, and good views from all seats.  Great AAA baseball experience.

name: Allen Voelcker
text: Awesome place to catch a ball game.

name: TheRealAudreyParker
text: Very nice stadium. Lots of parking (paid) restrooms throughout, and different foods to try.

name: Rita Bishop
text: Great ball park

name: Donald Dumler
text: Decent ballpark with plenty of parking and good choices for vendors in the concession area.

name: David Goodman
text: This is a fun ballpark.  It is so open and well laid out.  It does not feel crowded at all.  Great vendors without long lines.

name: Christopher Morrow
text: Outstanding place to watch a minor league baseball game. Food and drinks are good and reasonable.

name: Austin
text: Wish there was more shade but nice place

name: Ryan Schuetzler
text: Had a lot of fun taking the family to a Stormchasers game. The games are always fun, and there are lots of little activities between innings to keep the little ones at least a little interested. The kids like to sit on the berm and watch the game, hoping to catch a home run ball. It's nice because tickets are cheap enough that we can go for a while, wander around for a bit, and go home when the kids get tired without feeling like we have to stay the whole time to get our money's worth.

name: Nicholas Glenn
text: This is your typical run of the mill baseball stadium. Prices are extremely high for food and drinks that are mediocre at best. One perk to this stadium is the small area for children to play in if they begin to get restless while watching the game, but this comes at an additional cost. It is a fairly new facility, so all the amenities are in great shape, but cleanliness isn't a top priority. Chances are, if you are going to this stadium, it is to watch and cheer for your favorite team.

name: David Bradley
text: Great, family friendly ball park. Like most parks, there is a ton of promotions that can help with the cost. There is a lot to keep kids occupied if baseball isn't their interest. Concessions can be a little pricey but nothing beyond what you would expect at any sporting event.

name: Karen Svoboda
text: Had a great time at the game. Jack Daniels area was great.

name: XieXie ThankYou
text:
Beautiful Small Ball Park

It is a bit far out there, but it was worth going there. You might have a bit of a long line so better purchase ahead of time if possible. You will be very well entertained and the food was not bad, great baseball atmosphere. The kids love it here, lots of interaction with mascots and play area.

From the mascots to the baseball players, they really love the kids here and the kids love it here as you can hear them laugh with joy as they have a great time.

name: Mj Matthews
text: Always fun going to the ball game. 5The stadium is very clean and all of the workers are very friendly.

name: LeeAnn Rolloff
text: My experience at the park has been great.  The huge problem I have is I bring my pup to Bark in the Park so that means we sit on the Berm.  I love interacting with !all the other dogs.  HERE IS MY ISSUE:  I finally found a sand chair that I could bring sit in the back of the grassy area.  The concrete is very hard.  Some lady that apparently works for Werner told me I could not bring my sand chair in the Berm.  I am very confused by this statement.  I did take my SAND CHAIR back to my car.  I tried to explain to her that it is difficult for me to sit on the ground.  She could care less and wouldn't even give me a minute of her time other than to tell me I couldn't bring the chair in.  I do not recall anything written about no chairs.  A guy came in with stadium chair and sat in the Berm.  A guy came in with a wagon full of stuff and was in the berm.  I dont understand how this makes any sense.  People are in the Berm with strollers.  I just dont get it and would like some insight.  This is why you dont get 5 stars.

name: William White
text: Always a great time and fun place to watch a ball game

name: Lisa Clark
text: A great place to spend an evening.

name: Daniel Hedrick
text: Rock and Roll Lights was awesome.

name: Joseph McClaren
text: Great, small, family friendly ballpark for watching Triple A level baseball.  Promotions most nights to draw crowds and special events usually fill them to capacity.   Definitely need to go to more games.  Parking prices are reasonable, yet seem unnecessary  (old park never charged for parking).  Free parking within walking distance from nearby neighborhood is a great alternative.

name: Kathryn Greenwood
text: Great ballpark. Love going to watch stormchasers

name: Justin Barker
text: Very cool baseball experience for fans of all ages. The staff is very friendly and the ballpark is beautiful. There is not a bad seat in the stadium, the in game promotions are entertaining, and the food options are very good. Overall a great time at the ballpark. Can't wait to go back.

name: Don Lund
text: Werner Park is fan friendly. You are always close to the field. We had a company Picnic there so we got food, and the kids we were able to ride the Merry-go-round, play in bouncing houses, and a playground set. Fun experience for the whole family.

name: Paul Eide
text: My favorite place to spend the summer with friends and kids

name: damon gray
text: Great place to watch a game and definitely a family friendly environment!

name: Emily Liionlickr
text: This is why I don't like capitalism, clean and nice stadium tho

name: Sue Klein
text: Family friendly and fun. Staff is great!

name: Brian Borchers
text: The ball park is way out in Sarpy County, but other than that, the roads in and out are well planned.  It's a modern design where you can see the field from the concourse.  Plenty of seats in the shade.

name: Donna Ryan
text: Great atmosphere and family friendly!

name: Jim McWilliams
text: Fun, Fun family entertainment. The park was designed with families in mind and certainly fills the need for major league baseball in Omaha. Well almost major league anyway. Fill up the minivan with your kids and their friends, grab some hot dogs, peanuts and Cracker Jacks then have a fun day. For baseball I only give five stars to Wrigley Field, Dodger Stadium and the like. No 4.5 option available. Just go! I love this place! You will too.

name: Grant Baker
text: One of the better triple a stadiums. Obviously the food is expensive, though they do have a portion of their parking lot set aside for free parking. The staff does a good job.

name: Jordan Fiorini
text: Nice park.  Great baseball. Cheap seats.

name: Darren Wright
text: Great time at the ballpark.  No complaints.

name: Draven Sanctus
text: Lots of fun at this stadium. There are many things for kids to do if they don't want to sit still through an entire game. Food is good, over priced like all stadium good, and I'd stay away from the BBQ joint the meat really isn't worth the price. Aside from that it's always fun to see a Royals I mean golden spikes I mean storm chasers game and see who might be working their way up.

name: Don Hollie
text: Nice little ball park to watch a triple A baseball game.

name: Dale Kaup
text: From relaxed atmosphere.. But watch out for food balls.

name: Lisa Echols
text: Nice place, lots of food and beverage choices. Great fireworks tonight by Hy-Vee!

name: P Limbach
text: The boxes are nice so is general admission. The summer concerts they have are a lot of fun. The whole stadium and concourse are nice and clean.

name: Teri Clark
text: Great for family fun, tons to do!  There is a little baseball field, a play area (it does cost extra) and tons of food options!

name: Bradley Moran
text: Fun little stadium with plenty of food and drink options.

name: K B
text: Awesome evening g at the ball park...Thank you S.T.A.....we rock !!

name: Laurie Archuleta
text:
Easiest ballpark to be in.
The 'special' parking (lot A) could be announced better. But paying $5 for parking in lots B and up is good. They were even able to accept a card for payment.
Roomy seating with cup holders.

name: Dan Leaman
text: Lots of things for kids and parents to do and vendors. Great ball park to watch games.

name: Antonio Pierre
text: Can't wait to take my bambinos here. Looks amazing!

name: Sean O
text: Very nice ball park with a family atmosphere.

name: Remedios Hemmingson
text: Good family fun time!

name: Kolton Hammer
text: I like it a lot better than TD Ameritrade.

name: Luke Reisser
text: What a great place to bring the family. Family Fun Zone, great food, and if course watching baseball.

name: Cole Sargent
text: We like going to Werner Park quite a bit as a family.  It's easy to get into to, and has a layout that allows for a casual environment.  It's a nice place to spend an evening.  Very clean.

name: Greg Goll
text: Love this place, go take in a game. Get club section tickets and get access to the Jim Beam bar, also have a waitress that comes to your seat

name: Tim Snyder
text: Best minor league park out there

name: Barbara Hooper
text: My favorite place to watch baseball.  Small, well planned park with great variety of food and drink options.  Excellent for families and kids.  Options that are adult only also.  Nice blend.

name: Ellen Durham
text: Nice to attend the Walk for Crohn's

name: Lee Volkens
text: Great park for the storm chasers! Great atmosphere for all families. Our family took our dog to the Bark in the Park and had great time. Dogs are free admission. Parking is 5 dollars unless you park on North gravel lot then it's free.

name: Rene Gleason
text:
Pros: Family Fun, Good BallPark Food, Upbeat Atmosphere and Music, Great Baseball, Fireworks Show for 4th Of July was with Music and Great, really no bad seats.
Cons: Parking, Food $$

name: Michael Holdcroft
text: The service and family atmosphere here has slipped.  Need to get back to valuing your fans.

name: Mike Reddy
text: Awesome ball park with no bad seat anywhere. Decent food and drink prices for AAA team park that feeds championship KC Royals teams. Autograph bridge to meet the players every game, fireworks on weekends, lots of local promotions, just a fun time for the whole family.

name: Jason Weaver
text: Pretty cool experience for minor league baseball. Very new facility. Best view from the sections behind home plate. The five bucks for the Kid's Zone is a great investment. Many, many gluten-free concession options throughout the park.

name: Jota Ramos
text: Great park and awesome baseball team

name: Nicole McDowell
text: The kids have so much fun here.  I love how family friendly it is.

name: Bob Urz
text:
nice hometown ballpark
not too big not too small

name: Dave Swenson
text: Fun place,. Great time for the whole family.

name: Mark Holmes
