name: T J
text: This place is fantastic, to the people that are giving 3 and 4 star reviews because you have to order in the alley or because the line is long and it takes awhile doesn’t make any sense. Covid and being busy is not their fault, how can you say the ice cream is great and you like the atmosphere, and not give them 5 stars. Rate the actual business and not Covid, or long lines. 🙄

name: Natasha Dearness
text: Great ice cream,  great customer service, cute little shop, and AMAZING humor. All of my pictures are older but help explain and unfortunately I eat the ice cream too fast for pictures.

name: Dirk Zwart
text: I liked the ice cream, flavors, and gluten free cones. Our server separately washed and cleansed before handling gluten free items.

name: Olivia Dickert
text: It’s ice cream so unless something goes horribly wrong I will enjoy it. Service was kind and ordering out of an alley (thanks COVID) was a new but fun experience.

name: Sanger
text: Friendly staff with amazing ice creams...my favorite one is Pistachio, but it done so fast. Fresh Strawberries is never fail me. Their ice creams are not too sweet compared to other and very consistent in their ingredients. No places like this place. Come and meet Kaitlin and Jeremy...

name: Ella Schwab
text: All the classics and something interesting every time you’re there. The smell of the waffle cones is amazing.

name: Yuriy Gula
text: Walking in to the place had a good vibe to it. Walking  up to order the staff wasn't friendly, and not very happy to answer my questions. The line was long so they weren't happy that it wasn't moving as fast as they wanted it to. Overall the ice cream was decent, no complaints. But it's cash only. 21st century and no credit card reader...

name: Angela Flowers
text: I like this place because the Ice cream is soo delicious. The ice cream is made there and usually on a daily basis they change the flavors based on which ice creams were made. I like that you can sample taste them to see if you like the ice cream or not. Some flavors can be very interesting and delicious. The only thing that prevents a 5 star would be that they do not accept debit or credit cards. You must pay with cash or check.

name: Claire Gager
text: Awesome atmosphere and gluten free cones!  I had the chocolate which was good and my husband had the love of the month which he was happy with it was going toward big brothers big sisters a great organization.

name: John WoodenKnife
text: Very cool place, they make their ice cream on the spot they got the old machinery still whirring away making new flavors to try. Parking can be an issue depending on the time of day you go there but definitely worth checking out when visiting the Haymarket.

name: Erin Ng
text: Great local ice cream shop with awesome flavors. They now accept cards (it used to be cash only), which makes it even better. The only downside to Ivanna Cone is everyone wants their ice cream, so sometimes you have to wait 15-20 minutes... but the ice cream is definitely worth the wait! They also have a walk-up window open in the alley in the summers, which is usually quicker but not as many flavors.

name: Pauravi Gandhi
text:
Great flavors! We were driving back from Hastings and stopped by Lincoln downtown for dinner! It’s a busy place but worth the wait! Friendly staff and full of fragrance (which I personally felt very positive).

It’s a must go!

name: Aaron Rogge
text: Some of the best ice cream in town. They make their own ice cream and the flavors change regularly. There is usually a line, especially on the weekend -- the place is popular, but don't let that stop you. It is worth the wait. My favorite flavors are 'run raisin' and cinnamon. Sadly they don't always have them, but I have never not been satisfied.

name: Katherine Ericks
text: Extremely welcoming establishment. Delightful selection of absurdly tasty ice cream. It can be busy at rush hour but the employees all seem very efficient at what they do so the long lines zip by quickly. Haven't sampled the most of the selection just yet, but from what I have I'd certainly recommend the Butter Beer flavor (if I remember the name correctly). Worth a trip after work, or worth taking the family on the weekends.

name: Kelly Robertson
text: Ivanna Cone makes my heart sing. On a cold, blustery evening on Thanksgiving weekend, we were in Lincoln visiting extended family for the holiday. Despite the chilly weather, I am SO happy we came inside to this adorable ice cream shop!Pro-tip, try the waffle cone. It's made with cinnamon sugar, making it truly a delight! All their ice creams are made in-house. I also love that they use real, metal tasting spoons (hooray sustainability). Service is kind and so friendly!

name: Micah Block
text: Smooth, rich, and creamy! Some of the best ice cream in Lincoln.

name: Laura Lee
text: Whenever I visit Lincoln, even in the dead of winter, I have to get ice cream at Ivanna Cone! I love their creative flavors. One of the few who still make their ice cream in the store with White Mountain freezers.

name: Brendon Landis
text: Delicious ice cream and the lady that served us was fun to talk to and very well informed.

name: Cathy Wright
text: This is the cutest ice cream shop with it's brick walls and industrial yet old style decor. The ice cream is so good with lots of interesting names and three cone options to choose from. Located inside a historic Haymarket building that's like an indoor mini-mall which houses several other eclectic stores.  Fun, unique place.

name: Christian Guinac
text: You can never go wrong with Ivanna Cone, definitely the total package when it comes to ice cream experience. Awesome location, fun decorations, great service, and of course delicious ice cream. The only "complaint" I have is that they don't accept card but that's not too big of a deal because there's an ATM in the building if I forget.

name: Carrie McDaniel
text: Such a treat and love their ice cream

name: Jasmine
text: I got one of their current specials 'sweet love' and it was super decadent and delicious. It is even better than their Dutch chocolate which I didn't think was possible. Their ice cream is always fantastic, the staff always friendly and the service always quick. It is cash or check only though so be prepared or have to pay the fee at the nearby ATM.

name: Danny Jackson
text: Nice place very impressed with wait person who took our order. Yummy stuff.

name: Mark Kashman
text: Absolutely thick and delicious homemade style ice cream parlor, and right in the middle of Haystack Market. Grab a scoop or two and then wander - especially good on a hot summer NE day.

name: Whitt Whitton
text: Purple Cow tastes like purple. Okay, it's actually blackberry and white chocolate and deliciousness. Good vegan choices and always a line out the door. I'd be willing to bet that restaurants in the Haymarket don't sell many desserts because everyone goes to Ivanna Cone after dinner.

name: Braden Johnson
text: Best place in town to get ice cream. Fun flavors that change often. Pretty small place so I recommend you get it to go. Addition of a window to order from in Art Alley really helps wait times.

name: Allyson Thiel
text: The ice cream is great, I love the variety of flavors. Hipster-esque atmosphere, if you're into that sort of thing. Good date night idea.

name: Nell Price
text: This is a must do when I'm in Lincoln. It's the cutest little ice cream shop. It makes you feel like you are going back in time, but with a hip-vibe. Located in the happening Haymarket district there is ample public parking available. When you get there they will allow  you sample pretty much anything on a teeny tiny spoon. One of my favorite things here is the rosewater flavored ice cream. I LOVE rosewater and it's usually really hard to find in anything, let alone an ice cream flavor! They d on't always have it, but when they do I highly recommend for a very unique experience. I've also sampled the waffle cones

name: E Salkan
text: Great tasting ice  Cream. I love how they mix it up everyday.... The free condoms come in handy as well 😆

name: John Losito
text: If you take eclectic and freeze it you make Ivana Cone.

name: Mary Sanchez
text: Been many times before and never disappointed. Bit pricey compared to other ice cream shops but it's local and made each day so I don't mind paying a bit extra. Took my husband there for the first time and he liked it.

name: adam lueders
text: My son and I really liked their peanut butter, marshmallow, and already forgot the third ingredient sorry

name: Dawn Sayer
text: If you've never had Ivanna Cone don't over think it. You will only regret not going! Worth the price and worth waiting in line!

name: Jeremy Borakove
text: Best Ice Cream, best staff, best of lincoln Hands down

name: Frederick A Collins Jr
text: 🍒 sorbet is to die for! Waffle cone is a must have.

name: Xavier Ringo
text: Super great ice cream with very nice staff. They do not accept EFT, but there is an ATM right outside to get cash. Connected to a fun bookstore as well!

name: Manny Portillo
text: We love there ice cream. Every time we are in Lincoln we stop by.

name: Sabra Rodriguez
text: Love their ice cream and waffle cones! A bit pricey in my opinion, but I've never had ice cream that compares. Also, it gets packed on the weekends and only takes cash or check.

name: jenna 2005
text: Always delicious, employees are great 😁

name: Kyle McKay
text: Always delicious. Now they can take CC too so if you dont have cash or check you can still taste the smoothest ice cream in town

name: Amber Mikkelsen
text: Ivanna Cone has helpful and friend staff, and a wide variety of unique and classic flavors. They also have vegan options!

name: Paul Schwarze
text: Had I realized that they had a soda fountain, I'd have been there sooner. It always smells so good.

name: NaNessa Reyes
text: Hands down the best in Lincoln to get crazy good flavors of ice cream, they also have a few vegan options! The shop has a unique vibe that you're not going to find at other ice cream shops. Don't forget your cash!

name: Mister Kruger
text: Always good flavors!

name: Shelby Larsen
text: A Lincoln must-try. Best place to get ice cream, hands down. Staff is always super friendly, and going is always a great experience.

name: Casey Murphy
text: The closest I can get to east coast ice cream is Ivanna Cone, and boy is it addictive! Love their atmosphere and AMAZING strawberry ice cream they make right in shop, not to mention their homemade waffle cones. Ivanna cone is always my favorite way to celebrate just about anything!

name: Vinh Ho
text: Very good ice cream. Locally sourced and made in house with a limited flavor list every day made fresh daily. The lines always looks long but the workers help move it along very quickly. It's CASH only so be prepared. There's limited seating inside though so not for large groups.

name: Stan Smith
text: Everyone told me y'all made the best ice cream on the planet ... I'd say you're second best ... there's a place in Amsterdam that beats yours ... considering how many ice cream places there are on the spinning blue ball that's pretty good. I didn't ding you a star like I normally would when I think a business is needlessly using single-use plastic because y'all were doing well overall ... maybe you could look into using biodegradable spoons of some sort ... just an idea!!!

name: Dongxue Shi
text: My kid love this place. The only thing to complain is that they only accept cash. And when you forgot to bring your cash it was really disappointing

name: Franklin Pietraszuk
text: Unique flavors with a interesting  somewhat stringy texture

name: Kyle Yeramyshev
text: Love everything about this place! Great ice creams and sorbet.

name: Dell Richmond
text: Nothing like fresh ice cream in a house made waffle cone. Highly recommended!!

name: Patricia French
text: Simply the best ice cream in town! Made in store, lots of flavors and sizes available.

name: Breanna B
text: Yummy ice cream (about 10 different flavors, some standard flavors, some unique), friendly staff, and fun atmosphere.

name: Cat Rock
text: Fantastic ice cream! My one complaint is that it's cash only; in this day and age, a business should probably get a card reader. That being said, the entire place gives off a nostalgic, vintage vibe, and their cash only policy fits in with that. Ivana Cone's unique and ever-changing menu of ice cream and frozen treats never fails to leave me wanting more, and I plan to be back soon

name: Susan Fritz
text: Great place to get a cone or dish of ice cream. Friendly staff should offer sugar free or low sugar treats tho.

name: Alexis Saltzman
text: Always delicious, variety of rotating flavors so you never get bored. I think they are decently priced but I do wish they were a little less expensive so I could talk myself into going more often! But it is one of my favorite places to go for treat yo self day

name: Denise Gallardo
text: Friendly customer service. Clean, comfortable atmosphere. Delicious banana shakes! Reasonable prices

name: In The Deep Quiet Night
text: They always come up with interesting flavors of ice cream. It is all homemade and slow churned to perfection. The place is very unique, as they have paint colors that you wouldn't expect. But the color scheme is awesome. They also sell some ice cream to take home and they sell other goodies, such as brownies. They also make their waffle cones in the store. The price is definitely worth their product!

name: Michele Cumpston
text: They have the best ice cream and I love the fact that they always have at least one vegan choice on the board.

name: Edgar Mateo Joaquin
text: Good ice cream, they always have a line but definitely worth the wait.

name: Sean Gierke
text: Good ice cream.  Amused by the trash can decoration

name: Kimberly Stanke
text:
New Review: Staff consistently go above and beyond. They have added the ability to process credit cards!! Added a star!

Old Review: Amazing ice cream and atmosphere. Slightly expensive - 3.50 for one scoop in a plain cone. Limited seating and cash/check only make it less than perfect,  however.

name: Sammy Harper
text: Good ice cream and really cool atmosphere. We went during dinner time on a cold day so it wasnt very busy, but one time we walked by and the line was out the door. It's kinda pricey but it's a must stop.

name: April Morrison
text: Excellent service and great place to get a treat.

name: Roderick Hansen
text: Great stop in the Haymarket for homemade ice cream! Limited on seating, but you can usually find a spot.

name: John Potter
text: I cannot express enough how grateful and awesome my visit was to this place. The coworker was literally so kind and helpful with my order. He was literally so nice, I usually never tip at icecream stores as I feel they should pay a livable wage but he went and found an icecream boat for us because we split 3 scoops. Answered any questions we had. Asked about our day. Super super friendly and just all around great experience. A must stop if you’re in lincoln

name: Jim Brodhagen
text: The best ice cream joint in town! Locally owned and always serving up creative flavors. Personal favorite: Blue Moon. This is a regular stop any time out-of-town friends come to visit.

name: JDNS BLOCK
text: I love the ice cream and the vibes of this place super cute

name: Jazmin Nelson
text: Extremely good ice cream, and always a fun and creative selection of flavors. My favorite they ever had was chocolate banana. Have been on the lookout in case they ever bring it back. Can't go wrong with a waffle cone

name: Kevin Noonan
text: Great ice cream, great service.

name: Khedir Qassim
text: Lovely and quiet place to have a smoothie or ice cream in the haymarket area

name: David Morton
text: It's delicious! It's friendly! It's adventurous! I love it!

name: Josh Doppler
text: Fresh tasting. Delicious natural flavors.

name: Thomas Wuestewald
text: An amazing rotating menu with dairy free and vegan options in addition to ice cream sherbet and sorbet, homemade waffle cones, friendly staff and a quaint historic location make this home town icecream shop a must try.

name: James Gridley
text: Delicious seasonal lucky charm Irish breakfast mix.   Also gluten free options

name: LauraLee Woodruff
text: What an adventure! Had never heard of or tasted savory ice cream before. The line wrapping out the door AND out of the building says it all, and it's well worth the wait.  Love, love, love!

name: Emily Marvin
text: Do yourself a favor and try a weird flavor. The waffle cones are made there and they trade out flavors frequently. Always good, but the line can be incredible.

name: Crazyflowereater
text: Best ice cream in town. Great vegan options. Lovely atmosphere.

name: Airbrush Mike Art Garage
text: Awesome ice cream!!!! In the haute market area of lincoln.  We go there almost every time we are there!!!! Friendly staff. Free samples.  New flavors regularly. It is home made I believe.  They have the equipment there to prove it!!! We did home made ice cream in 6th grade it was good. This is better!!!!

name: Rebecca Root
text: Girl scouts thin mint cookie mint ice cream was delicious! 💚

name: Mark Mesarch
text: Good ice cream and supports local groups with percentage of days sales

name: Yassine
text: The best icecream, a bit pricy though

name: Steve Ramos
text:
Best ice cream place in Lincoln with ease.  Inventive flavors and such a good vibe.  The line is always long, but moves fast.  Cash only.

TTY he ice cream is dense and the waffle cones are always fresh made.  Not sure how they can keep up with demand.

name: Ben Geyer
text: It’s a fun atmosphere inside and the ice cream is good (comparable to Cold Stone). I would definitely reccomend sampling a couple before buying one. My only complaints are that they don't accept cards, and when I finished paying they didn’t give me a receipt.

name: Jonathan Reyes
text: They've​ got some really weird flavors; if memory serves me, I'm pretty sure that I can recall a "bleu cheese with grilled onions" flavor once. But you can stick to the traditional sweet cream or Dutch chocolate. The texture, though, wins me over every time. It's hard to describe, but 'slightly chewy', I think, comes close. Ivanna Cone is consistently voted as one of the (if not THE) best ice cream in the state. I'd even wager it beats any of the ice cream from the surrounding states.

name: Alyssa Mowery
text: Absolutely on the list of must-visit places in Lincoln. Whether you get your ice cream from the walk-through window or go inside, you won't be disappointed by either their classic or unique offerings - and the waffle cones are amazing too!

name: Veranda Johnson
text: Great homemade ice cream and sherbet.  There are rotating flavors with a wide variety for many tastes. Free samples and awesome waffle cones.  Bring cash for deliciousness.

name: Shawn Krogh
text: Love the ice cream best in town

name: Cory Bennett
text: Homemade deliciousness and some of the best icecream I have had in ages. For a first-timer I was overwhelmed with possibilities. Recommendation: double scoop of your favorites, in a waffle cone, sundae style! Be ready for cash or check only; NO plastic.

name: Stacie Sinclair
text: Best ice cream in Lincoln, we bring all out out-of-town guests here!

name: Danielle Borland
text: Best ice cream in town.  No one can match thier variety and original flavors.

name: Amy Spencer
text: Delicious ice cream. Friendly servers. Little pricey.

name: Tori Phillips
text: So many awesome options! Best way to try the most is to share a 6 mini scoop plate

name: Amanda S
text: A great selection of crazy and classic ice cream flavors. The ice cream is really creamy and they have excellent waffle cones here. Would highly recommend!

name: Jenny Fam
text: Ivanna has the best ice cream in Lincoln. The flavors are always changing so there's always new flavors to choose from! You'll never get bored. Personal favorite: fresh strawberry is really refreshing!

name: Anamarie Garcia Moura
text: I'll say service is great but I would prefer to go to Cold Stone for more flavor choices!

name: Jacob Kramer
text: Informative and friendly staff. I had the butter brickle and it was delicious.

name: Kyle Portell
text: Great ice cream, fun environment, friendly staff. Theres nothing bad you can say about this place!

name: Jatia Buchholz
text: Best ice cream in town! Everyone must try at least once because you'll be hooked after that! Always friendly service! Great atmosphere!

name: Kelli L Kraft
text: Always excellent service and great ice cream!

name: Rosa Vallejo
text: Love the icecream here!

text:
I tried Dutch Chocolate ice cream.

text: Best ice cream shop I have ever been to, In the states.we get vegan fresh fruit sorbet and the children area is delightful! It enhances the bookstore, ceramic store and theater making for an appropriate kid date

name: Stevens Berry
text: AMAZING ice cream in incredible flavors.

name: Jeff Ghoti
text: The best place in Lincoln for unique and traditional ice cream flavors. Locally owned and operated. Come early there is almost always a line out the door but it moves fast.

name: Eric Brown
text: Fresh home made ice cream.  I really enjoyed the chocolate flavor they offer.

name: Thomas Laws
text: Ice cream is always great and tons of ever changing flavors

name: Kelly Pierce

text: Waited nearly 2 hours for our food. Waitress stated only 1 cook was working. She kept coming back saying “food will be here shortly”, approximately “5-10 minutes.” 20 minutes later still no food. Had to stay past closing time and take food to go. Horrible service.

resp.text: Hi Andy, We apologize that you had a bad experience tonight.  It's very difficult for us to predict how to staff because business has been very volatile Downtown with the Covid restriction. Last Monday, out busiest hour was $168, which one Bartender and one cook can easily handle.  Tonight we had $421 hour - more than double, and quite frankly we just weren't staffed for it.  We will add an additional person for next Monday and make sure that we can give the great service that has kept us in business for nearly 30 years.  Again, sorry you caught us on a bad night.  If you message us your address on FaceBook or give us a call, we would be happy to send you a Gift Certificate so you can come back and give us another try.

text:
Zero stars. I was really excited to try these supposed "best wings in town". I had an order to be done at a specified time. They finished it an hour early and offered to keep it warm. No other offer. What am I going to do with wings that have sat under a heat lamp for an hour? I'm not even sure Golden Corral let's them sit that long. How can they be the best wings in town when the restaurant is willing to let them sit for an hour? Those can't be any good. And to expect me to pay for them? At full price, too?

I will never be going to any of the Watering Holes in Lincoln, NE. Way to blow it.

resp.text: Sorry we had to clean it up!  One of our cooks put his foot through the floor back in 2011 - the place was literally falling apart, so we took it down to bare walls and floor and built it to last another 100 years.  Glad to hear you still love our wings & pierogies!

name: Shana LaPointe
text: I only been here once. The wings were delicious. I only had two orders of boneless honey bbq wings and french fries. The first order of wings and french fries were a little cold. The second order was toasty!

name: Abuggeek Named Meatloaf
text:
USED TO BE the best wings in Lincoln.  I suspect either ownership or management changed. In any event, the place has gone downhill. The food is often poorly prepared and presented even more poorly. Sad.

Nice tap beer selection .... If you can get a second. Understaffed. Poorly managed. Present employees lack respect for managerial hierarchy.

How this place is still open in beyond me

name: Peggy Onwiler
text: We stopped in for a drink and an appetizer. The service was great and out time was relaxing.

resp.text: Thank you for the review. We are glad you enjoyed your time, service, food and drinks. We hope to see you again!

name: Liana Sandin
text: Nice quiet place for an early supper. Wings with apricot sauce are awesome IF you ask for sauteed onion with them.  Service is very attentive and friendly.

name: MJ D
text: This place has THE BEST grilled hot wings! I drive to Lincoln sometimes just to get them.

name: Jason Oglesby
text: Best chicken wings in Lincoln. Order them grilled, they take a bit longer but well worth the wait.

name: Mrs Nutz
text: Awful service. They really need to get their service together. Was totally blown off by the bartender, had to search for my own ketchup and find my own drink refills.

name: nick rutt
text: A Lincoln institution great wings and bar food

resp.text: Thank you for the revieiw! We can't wait to serve you the best wings again!

name: Katharine H.
text: Absolutely amazing grilled chicken wings (with the Old Bay seasoning). Worth the extra wait! Also they make really good Moscow Mules.

name: Trevor Hickman
text: Great food.  Great wings.  Expensive drinks.  Charged me $2 for getting a drink on the rocks instead of neat.  $2 for ice

name: Dan
text:
Love their beer selection and specials. Kind staff and seem to be a more chill place to drink in the downtown area. Definitely moved up a few notches on my list after my last visit.
I hear the wings are good.

name: Cory Leedom
text: You can't go wrong food is good, drinks are cold, and staff has been pleasant every time I go in

name: Joshua Loibl
text: Nice place downtown Lincoln. Good eats and great drinks 👍

name: Stephanie Reed
text: Excellent service and food!!

name: Jeff Eveland
text: The grilled hot wings are the best wings I've ever had.  You will fall in love with them.  Also, great craft beers here.

name: Alex Otto
text: Thursday's special is the best reason to come here. Patty Melt Thursdays, the place to eat downtown!

name: Spencer Hall
text: Drinks are reasonably priced and there's usually decent food and drink specials most days. The last time I was there though the waitress told us up front that the kitchen would take probably 40 minutes since they were super busy. That was okay so we ordered food. It showed up almost two hours later. In the meantime however, the waitress was very prompt with any drink orders and very apologetic and in the end the manager took off a decent chunk of the bill.

name: Caleb Berggren
text: Best wings in town. Get the grilled hot wings, they are super savory. $2 Empyrean (great local brewery) pints after 10 p.m. Thurs-Sat. It's a steal for good beer. Relatively nice interior, western-themed, good selection of TV's by the bar.

name: Edward Boone
text: Well, the wings are good. I can say that about this place. But they weren't, like, mind-blowing amazing. And certainly not worth waiting 40 minutes for. In the middle of a weekday. When  there's 8 other tables in the whole restaurant. I don't know how many people in Lincoln get a two-hour-long lunch break from work, but unless you are one of those people, I would recommend going somewhere else for lunch.

name: Dillan Ronne
text: Amazing food. I can't say the service was the most attentive, however they were very kind. I would go back.

name: Prosper VanderWeijden
text: Its hit and miss here with the wait staff. Good food most of the time. Got some real nasty fish here one time.

name: Eric Wentz
text: It's not great, service and price is a 2 star, owned by not great people and the staff seems to turn over every other season. BUT THE GRILLED WINGS! They are so good, I happily put up with it all. Go here, try them.

name: Mike Madas
text: Great food good atmosphere. One of the few bars downtown where you can go have a drink and have a conversation with someone without the music blaring.

name: Alex Kennell
text: Good wings but the Buffalo is kinda scary.

name: Todd Grier
text: Wings are sold in odd amounts and too expensive. For a couple to eat wings and drink a beer you can easily spend over $50...for wings. Mediocre service is the mainstay here as well

name: Denise Boever
text: Best wings and great service.

name: William Gilbert
text: this place sucks, they saw me sitting at the bar, and did not ever serve me for 1 hr. after that, they got there wish I left, and went to another bar, that did appreciate my business.  there are plenty of other bars in this town, and most of them are glad to serve me.  FYI:  I drink responsibly, and if they thought I was drunk, then they should have politely asked me to leave.  to even let a drunk just sit at the bar can get them a bar violation.  further more, it is just as well that management don't contact me, as then they would just be smart about it.  this is my experience with this place.

name: Derek Andersen
text:
(edit)Grilled wings were great. Service is terrible, but that is part of the charm in my book. No longer the best eats downtown.
The renovation has removed all of the charm from what was formerly the best bar on O st. Add in that some clown decided to replace the grill that produced what were the best chicken wings in the country...I hate the new digs.

Everyone else enjoyed their food and everyone else exept me enjoyed there alcoholic beverages too. The only complaint with the food was the onion rings which was hard to eat cause the onion slid out of the deepfried shell.
